# 1. Ringkasan Padat

## 1.1 Identitas

- Nama produk: **Dnialify Music Stream** (`dnialify-music-stream`).
- Kategori: pemutar musik web bergaya Spotify yang memakai katalog YouTube Music; tanpa akun, tanpa login, tanpa database pengguna.
- Versi: native/APK `3.1.0`; web `3.5.1`; keduanya dari `package.json` (satu sumber kebenaran, disuntik ke aset oleh `scripts/inject-version.js`).
- Pembuat: Dnialify Project. Kontak publik ada di `/api/meta` dan README (WA 089648528585, FB/IG/X/Telegram @dann4lfat_).
- Lisensi: ISC. Proyek tidak berafiliasi dengan YouTube/Google/Spotify; audio diputar lewat player resmi YouTube atau proxy stream milik server sendiri.
- Dua wujud distribusi: (a) situs statis + serverless di Vercel, (b) aplikasi Android Capacitor yang membungkus aset web yang sama dan menambah mesin audio native + cache offline.
- Dump ini mencakup 161 berkas teks (2,097,261 byte, 47,129 baris) pada commit `a54ae5d`.

## 1.2 Tesis arsitektur

- **Satu aplikasi, tiga lapisan eksekusi**: SPA (`public/app.js`) → Express (`server.js`) → YouTube InnerTube. Di Android, lapisan keempat masuk: `NativeAudioEngine` (ExoPlayer/MediaPlayer) + `PlaybackService` (foreground service + MediaSession) + cache SQLite/filesystem.
- **Tanpa SDK YouTube di server**: semua metadata diambil dengan `POST https://music.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/<endpoint>` memakai konteks `WEB_REMIX` dan header yang meniru browser. Tidak ada API key, tidak ada OAuth.
- **Audio punya dua jalur**: (1) IFrame Player API resmi (paling aman, lintas-origin, tidak bisa di-cache), (2) stream langsung `googlevideo.com` via proxy `/api/stream` (byte-range, bisa di-cache, dipakai untuk offline). Jalur 1 adalah fallback default ketika jalur 2 gagal (`signatureCipher` tidak bisa di-decipher).
- **State milik klien**: favorit, playlist, riwayat, statistik, antrean, pengaturan disimpan di `localStorage`; tidak ada sinkronisasi akun. Backup/restore manual berupa JSON.
- **Offline native-first**: hanya APK yang bisa offline. Cache = potongan 1 MB di filesystem + metadata SQLite; browser biasa belum punya jalur offline (rencana Service Worker + OPFS).
- **Gate versi berlapis**: backend memberi `/api/app-version`; frontend membandingkan versi native dan memaksa update; L60 menambal lubang versi `n/a`/null/non-semver yang sebelumnya lolos.

## 1.3 Alur pemutaran (ringkas)

```text
klik lagu
  -> openSongNowPlaying()  [app.js ~4403]
  -> playSong(song, queue, index)  [~1824]
     -> pilih engine: native (Capacitor + mode VISIONOS) atau web
        native: startNativeTrack() -> NativePlayback.play(url|videoId)
                -> NativeAudioEngine.resolveAndStart() -> ExoPlayer/MediaPlayer
        web   : playViaAudio() -> <audio src="/api/stream?videoId=...">
                gagal -> /api/audio -> IFrame YT.Player
  -> onTrackChanged() -> renderNowPlaying(), lyrics, queue, MediaSession, notif
  -> progressLoop() (requestAnimationFrame) -> progress bar + native state push
```

- Bila `NativePlayback` tidak ada (browser) seluruh jalur native dilewati; `isAndroidNative()` di `app.js` (~293) jadi satu-satunya percabangan platform.
- Kegagalan stream tidak mematikan aplikasi: ada rantai fallback bertingkat (stream → audio → iframe; native → iframe → skip).

# 3. Stack, Dependensi, Perintah

## 3.1 Runtime

- Node.js >= 18 (dipakai `fetch`, `AbortController`, `node --test`).
- Express `^5.2.1` - satu-satunya dependensi runtime server.
- Capacitor `^6.2.1` (`core`, `cli`, `android`) untuk shell APK.
- Dev: ESLint `^8.57.1` (config `eslint:recommended`, `ecmaVersion 2022`), Prettier `^3.9.6`, `patch-package ^8.0.1` (postinstall).
- Android: Gradle + AGP, compileSdk/targetSdk mengikuti `android/variables.gradle`, JDK 17 di CI, `androidx.media3` (ExoPlayer + MediaSession), `NanoHTTPD` (server lokal untuk mode loopback/cache).

## 3.2 Skrip npm

| Skrip | Perintah | Fungsi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `node server.js` | server produksi di `0.0.0.0:3000` |
| `bump` | `node scripts/bump.js` | naikkan versi web + suntik ke aset + commit |
| `version:bump` | `node scripts/bump-version.js` | naikkan versi native/APK |
| `release` | `node scripts/release.js` | siapkan artefak rilis |
| `test` | `node --test --experimental-test-coverage` | unit test parser (fallback echo bila tidak ada) |
| `lint` | `eslint server.js public/app.js` | lint dua berkas inti |
| `fmt` / `fmt:check` | `prettier --write/--check server.js public/app.js` | format |
| `postinstall` | `patch-package` | menerapkan `patches/@capacitor+android+6.2.1.patch` |

- Tidak ada script `build`. Build web = statis; build APK = `npx cap sync android` + `./gradlew assembleDebug` (dijalankan CI).
- Tidak ada bundler/minifier: `app.js` dimuat langsung sebagai `<script>`, jadi ukuran dan urutan deklarasi harus dijaga manual.

## 3.3 Konfigurasi deployments

- `vercel.json`: `version: 2`, build `api/index.js` dengan `@vercel/node`, route `/(.*)` → `api/index.js`. Semua trafik (termasuk aset statis) masuk ke Express.
- `capacitor.config.json`: `appId com.dnialify.musicstream`, `webDir public`, `server.url https://dnialify-music-stream.vercel.app`, `androidScheme https`, splash 1200 ms, `allowMixedContent true`, `captureInput true`.
- Konsekuensi `server.url`: APK memuat aset dari jaringan, bukan bundel lokal - pembaruan web langsung terasa di APK tanpa rilis ulang, tetapi aplikasi butuh internet saat start (kecuali aset sudah di-cache WebView).
- `server.cleartext false` + `network_security_config` membatasi trafik ke HTTPS.

# 4. Backend: server.js

## 4.1 Kerangka

- `const app = express()`; `express.json()`; `app.set('trust proxy', 1)` agar `req.ip` benar di belakang Vercel.
- Versi: `APP_VERSION_SERVER = PKG.version`, `WEB_VERSION_SERVER = PKG.webVersion`, `BUILD_CHANNEL = env.BUILD_CHANNEL || (webVersion.includes("-beta") ? "beta" : "stable")`.
- `module.exports = app`; `app.listen` hanya jika `require.main === module` → satu berkas bisa jadi server dan handler serverless.
- Static: `express.static(public, { maxAge: 0, etag: true, lastModified: true })` dengan `setHeaders` per jenis berkas.
- Cache-Control: `index.html`, `app.js`, `sw.js`, `styles.css` → `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate` + `Pragma: no-cache` + `Expires: 0`. Aset lain → `public, max-age=3600`.
- Header keamanan: `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`.
- Rate limit in-memory: hanya path `/api/`, 90 permintaan / 60 detik per IP (`req.ip || x-forwarded-for || "anon"`), balasan `429 {error:"Too many requests, slow down."}` + `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. Tidak ada Redis; di serverless batas ini per-instance (jadi longgar, bukan proteksi keras).
- `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` di-hardcode (bukan dibaca dari disk) karena direktori berawalan titik tidak ikut build Vercel. Isi: `delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls`, package `com.dnialify.musicstream`, SHA-256 `F3:A2:...:E1:90`.
- Catch-all `app.use` mengirim `public/index.html` → router hash di klien menangani sisa path.
- Guard uji `BLOCK_YOUTUBE=1`: `globalThis.fetch` dipatch untuk menolak host `youtube.com`, `music.youtube.com`, `googlevideo.com`, `youtubei.googleapis.com`, `youtu.be`, `ytimg.com`. Tujuannya membuktikan pemutaran dari cache lokal tidak menyentuh YouTube sama sekali.

## 4.2 Konteks InnerTube

- `YTM = https://music.youtube.com/youtubei/v1`; `CONTEXT = { client: { clientName: "WEB_REMIX", clientVersion: "1.20240101.00.00", hl: "id", gl: "ID" } }`.
- Header: `Content-Type: application/json`, `Origin`/`Referer` `https://music.youtube.com`, UA Chrome 124 Windows.
- `yt(endpoint, body, query)` → `POST ${YTM}/${endpoint}?prettyPrint=false${query}` dengan body `{ context, ...body }`.
- Semua endpoint memakai pola ini; tidak ada signing/decipher di server, karena itu `signatureCipher` jadi titik gagal utama untuk audio langsung.

## 4.3 Helper parsing

| Helper | Fungsi |
| --- | --- |
| `findAll(obj, key, out)` | telusur rekursif mencari semua nilai dengan nama kunci tertentu |
| `findFirst(obj, key)` | versi berhenti-di-temuan-pertama |
| `text(o)` / `runsInfo(o)` | normalisasi `{runs:[{text}]}` atau `{simpleText}` jadi string |
| `normalizeDuration(s)` | `"3:21"` → detik |
| `thumbs(o)` / `upscale(url)` | ambil thumbnail, naikkan resolusi (`w544-h544`) |
| `endpointInfo(nav)` | ekstrak `browseEndpoint`/`watchEndpoint` dari navigasi |
| `parseTwoRow(r)` | baris dua kolom (shelf) → item |
| `parseListItem(r)` | `musicResponsiveListItemRenderer` → `{id,title,artist,album,duration,thumb}` |
| `parseSections(contents)` | daftar section → `[{title, items}]` |
| `cached(key, ttl, fn)` | Map in-memory + TTL, anti-duplikasi request |
| `etagFor(obj)` / `sendJsonWithCache(...)` | ETag + `Cache-Control` untuk respons JSON |
| `fetchTimeout(url, opts, 4500)` | `AbortController` 4,5 detik untuk provider lirik |
| `simScore(a,b)` + `norm` | kemiripan judul/artis untuk memilih lirik terbaik |

## 4.4 Jalur audio

- `getAudioUrl(videoId, clientOverride)` memanggil `youtubei/player` dengan konteks ANDROID, memilih `adaptiveFormats` bertipe `audio/*`, prefer `opus`.
- Bila hasil hanya `signatureCipher` (butuh decipher), fungsi mengembalikan `null`; klien lalu memakai IFrame. Ini keputusan sadar: tidak memelihara implementasi decipher yang rapuh.
- `YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT` (default `current`) memilih set klien; `VISIONOS_*` (context/headers/visitorData) dipakai sebagai klien alternatif yang lebih tahan terhadap `LOGIN_REQUIRED`.
- `GET /api/audio?videoId&debug` mengembalikan URL audio + metadata; `GET /api/stream?videoId&client` memproksikan byte dan **mendukung Range** (meneruskan `Range`, membalas `206` + `Content-Range`, `Accept-Ranges: bytes`). Ini yang membuat `<audio src="/api/stream?...">` bisa seek.
- Proxy yang sama membuat audio same-origin → menghindari CORS dan memungkinkan `MediaSession`/cache.

## 4.5 Cache audio persisten (server)

- `AUDIO_CACHE_DIR = env.AUDIO_CACHE_DIR || cache/audio`; `AUDIO_CHUNK = 102400` (100 KB per tulis).
- Berkas: `<videoId>.webm` (final), `<videoId>.part` (selama unduh), `<videoId>.song.json` + `<videoId>.lyrics.json` (metadata), `<videoId>.art` (artwork).
- `hasEbmlMagic()` memvalidasi header WebM sebelum berkas dianggap final → mencegah cache berisi HTML error.
- `downloadToCache(id, url, total, ua)` menulis bertahap; `readFinalCache`, `readCacheMeta`, `serveCacheFile(req,res,id)` melayani dengan Range.
- `GET /api/cache-audio` memicu unduh; `GET /api/local-audio` memutar dari cache; `GET /api/stream-diag` menguji resolve + probe byte.
- Catatan penting: cache server adalah cache **per instance**. Di Vercel filesystem efemeron/read-only sehingga fitur ini praktis hanya untuk self-host/VPS.

## 4.6 Lirik

- Rantai provider: `lyrics.ovh` → NetEase → LRCLIB (`/api/get` lalu `/api/search` + `pickBest`) → textyl → ekstraksi `MPLYt` dari YTM.
- `GET /api/lyrics?videoId&title&artist&album&duration` membalas `{synced, plain, source}`; `synced` berupa LRC (timestamp per baris) bila tersedia, jika tidak `plain`.
- `pickBest` memakai `simScore` terhadap judul/artis/durasi agar tidak salah pasang lirik.
- Semua provider dibungkus timeout 4,5 detik; kegagalan satu provider tidak menggagalkan respons.

# 5. Referensi API

Semua endpoint `GET`, JSON, di bawah `/api/`. Rate limit 90/menit/IP.

| Endpoint | Query | Keluaran |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/home` | `videoId?` | shelf beranda: recently played, mix, liked, playlist lokal, saved, shelf YTM |
| `/api/charts` | `videoId?` | tangga lagu + section |
| `/api/moods` | `q`, `filter` | kategori/mood + item |
| `/api/search` | `q`, `filter` | hasil terkelompok (lagu/video/album/artis/playlist) + top result |
| `/api/suggest` | `q` | saran pencarian |
| `/api/next` | `videoId`, `playlistId?`, `params?` | antrean radio/next dari YTM |
| `/api/related` | `videoId` | lagu terkait |
| `/api/browse` | `browseId`, `params?` | halaman browse generik (album/artis/playlist) |
| `/api/sponsorblock` | `videoId` | segmen SponsorBlock |
| `/api/lyrics` | `videoId`, `title`, `artist`, `album?`, `duration?` | `{synced, plain, source}` |
| `/api/thumb` | `url` | proxy gambar JPEG, cache 86.400 detik |
| `/api/audio` | `videoId`, `debug?` | URL audio langsung + metadata |
| `/api/stream` | `videoId`, `client?` | proxy byte audio, Range 206 |
| `/api/stream-diag` | `videoId`, `client?`, `probe?` | diagnostik resolve + probe |
| `/api/cache-audio` | `videoId` | mulai/serve cache |
| `/api/local-audio` | `videoId` | layani dari cache |
| `/api/download-start` | `videoId`, `progressUrl?` | mulai konversi MP3 (loader.to) |
| `/api/download-progress` | `progressUrl`, `url` | progres unduhan |
| `/api/resolve` | `url` | resolve URL share/redirect |
| `/api/app-version` | - | `{version, webVersion, appVersion, channel, assetCache, minVersion, updatedAt}` |
| `/api/health` | - | `{ok, app, version, uptime}` |
| `/api/meta` | - | identitas + kontak |

- `assetCache` = `dnialify-assets-v<webVersion>` dan harus sama dengan `CACHE` di `public/sw.js`; ini titik sinkronisasi invalidasi Service Worker.
- `minVersion` (`1.2.0` di server, gate efektif `3.0.0` di klien) dipakai UI untuk memaksa pembaruan APK.

# 6. Frontend: public/

## 6.1 Bentuk berkas

- `index.html` (42.734 byte): shell SPA. Berisi sidebar, topbar, area `#view`, panel kanan (now playing + antrean), mini bar, `<audio id="bg-audio">`, holder IFrame, lusinan modal, dan template kecil. Tidak ada framework; semua render lewat string HTML.
- `app.js` (351.746 byte, ~8.600 baris): seluruh logika klien. Urutan deklarasi penting karena semua berbagi satu scope IIFE besar.
- `styles.css` (98.624 byte, 2.269 baris, 918 rule): tema gelap/terang lewat CSS variable, layout responsif, animasi; CSS floating widget disuntik dari JS (`FW_CSS`).
- `sw.js` (1.615 byte): Service Worker `dnialify-assets-v<versi>`; precache `[`/`,`/index.html`,`/styles.css`,`/app.js`,`/logo.png`,`/logo-192.png`,`/manifest.json`]`; strategi: berkas "versioned" (navigasi, `/`, `.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`, `sw.js`) → network-first `cache: no-store`; sisanya cache-first; `/api/*` selalu dilewati.
- `manifest.json` + ikon: PWA installable; `diag.html`/`diag-hook.js`: halaman diagnosa audio/latar.
- `Appendiks penting`: aset di `android/app/src/main/assets/public/` adalah salinan yang dikirim ke WebView APK; bila berbeda dari `public/`, yang menang adalah versi di APK sampai `cap sync` dijalankan.

## 6.2 Bootstrap & helper

- Baris 2: IIFE `LogBuffer` menampung log dalam memori (untuk halaman diagnosa dan kirim ke native lewat `AppLogNative`).
- `APP_VERSION = "3.5.1"`, `BUILD_CHANNEL` (disuntik `inject-version.js`).
- `isAndroidNative()` (~293): `window.Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.()` atau `!!window.NativePlayback`.
- Helper: `$`/`$$` (querySelector), `esc` (escape HTML), `icon` (SVG inline), `api(path, opts)` (fetch + JSON + error handling + abort).
- `toast(msg)`/`showToast` (~412/425) untuk notifikasi ringan; `hueFrom`/`applyTint` (~429/436) mewarnai UI dari artwork.
- `fmtTime`, `fmtMs`, `parseDurationSec`, `normalizeDuration`, `looksLikePlays` utilitas format.

## 6.3 Penyimpanan klien

- `store` (~596): pembungkus `localStorage` dengan namespace. Beta membaca `smw_*` tapi menulis `smw_beta_*` → isolasi dua profil di domain yang sama.
- Kunci yang dipakai: `theme`, `fav`, `pls`, `sav`, `hist`, `stats`, `sb_on`, `yt_hq`, `volume_level`, `extra_volume`, `qstate`, `off`, `srec`, `search_filter`, `offline_pinned`, `offline_last_played`, `fw_pos`, `widget_home_pip`.
- Kunci mentah lain: `smw_username`, `dnialify_version`, `smw_user_data_version`, `max_cached_songs`, `chunk_window`.
- `Library` (~613): operasi favorit/playlist/saved/history/stats; `USER_DATA_VERSION = 1` + `migrateUserDataIfNeeded()` (~975) untuk migrasi skema data lokal.
- Backup/restore JSON: `backupLibrary()`/`restoreLibrary()` (~6228/6260).

## 6.4 Gerbang versi (termasuk L60)

- `VERSION_CHECK_INTERVAL = 5 menit`; `checkAppVersion({silent, force})` (~875) memanggil `/api/app-version`, membandingkan dengan `APP_VERSION`.
- `isNewerVersion` (~759) parser semver sederhana; `showVersionUpdateModal`/`applyVersionUpdate`/`clearWebsiteCacheOnly` mengelola pembaruan aset web (hapus cache SW lalu reload).
- `enforceNativeMinVersion()` (~924): menolak pemutaran bila versi APK < 3.0.0. **L60**: masukan `n/a`, `null`, `undefined`, atau string non-semver kini juga dianggap gagal → overlay "Update Diperlukan" muncul, menutup celah bypass yang sebelumnya membuat gate terlewati.
- Aturan L60: hanya `public/app.js` yang diubah; APK `3.1.0` dan versi valid >= 3.0.0 harus lolos.
- `ensureAppVersionBeforePlay()` (~910) dipanggil sebelum pemutaran pertama; `_gateCheckCount` membatasi percobaan.

## 6.5 Player & audio

- `Player` object (~1011) menyimpan state putar: `current`, `queue`, `index`, `playing`, `duration`, `position`, `nativeActive`, `skipStreak`, dll.
- `initAudio()` (~1208): menyiapkan `<audio>`, Media Session, dan memilih engine native vs web.
- Volume berjenjang `VOL_LEVELS = [0,50,100,200,300]` (~1007) - 200/300 memakai boost native (loudness) di APK, di web hanya mengubah `volume` (tidak ada boost nyata).
- `playViaAudio()` (~1588): set `audio.src = /api/stream?videoId=...`; gagal → `/api/audio`; gagal → IFrame `yt.loadVideoById`.
- `playSong(song, queue, index)` (~1824) adalah pintu tunggal pemutaran untuk lagu baru (memuat lirik, artwork, queue, MediaSession, riwayat); `previewSong()` (~4376) memutar cuplikan tanpa mengganggu lagu utama.
- `progressLoop(ts)` (~3057): `requestAnimationFrame`; memperbarui progress bar, posisi lirik, `navigator.mediaSession.setPositionState`, dan mendorong state ke native (`pushNativeState`).
- `renderPlayButtons`, `renderNowPlaying`, `updateLikeButtons`, `updateMediaSessionState`, `setMediaSessionForAudio` menjaga UI dan notifikasi tetap sinkron.
- SponsorBlock: `loadSponsorBlock` + `toggleSB` (segmen disimpan per video, tombol di now playing).
- Kecepatan: `SPEEDS` + `cycleSpeed` (0,5x–2x); memakai `playbackRate` native maupun elemen audio.
- Kualitas: `QUALITY_RANK`/`bestQuality`/`suggestedQuality`/`applyPlaybackQuality`/`toggleQuality` (~1667–1730) memilih kualitas IFrame (termasuk "max YouTube").

## 6.6 Antrean

- `queueSong`/`removeQueued`/`clearUserQueue` mengelola "Your queue" di atas antrean radio.
- `persistQueue`/`restoreQueue` (~1943/1959) menyimpan antrean ke `qstate` sehingga tahan refresh; `slimSong` memangkas payload.
- `moveQueued`/`moveQueueItem` + `QueueDrag` (~2027) menangani drag-and-drop (desktop).
- `fetchQueue` (~2663) memuat antrean dari YTM; `refillRadio` (~2711) menambah lagi saat mendekati ujung; `scrambleRadioQueue` mengacak bagian radio.
- `nextTrack(auto)` (~2768) & `prevTrack` (~2822): auto-next memakai aturan anti-stuck (tidak mengulang video yang sama, ada `skipStreak`).
- `queueDirty`/`markDirty`/`pushIfDirty`/`pushQueueWindow` (~2449–2467): sinkronisasi hemat tulis state ke native.

## 6.7 Navigasi & render

- `route()` (~4583) router berbasis hash; `NAV` (~4420) mendefinisikan `home`, `search`, `charts`, `library`, `settings`, `local_`.
- Cache halaman: `pageCache` + `PAGE_CACHE_TTL 90000` + `PAGE_CACHE_MAX 24` (~4564); `cacheGet`/`cacheSet`.
- `_vtRunning` (~4582) mencegah View Transitions bersarang - pernah menyebabkan layar hitam di WebView Android; aturan: satu transisi pada satu waktu.
- View: `viewHome` (~4697), `viewSearch` (~5186), `viewCharts` (~5265), `viewMoods` (~5321), `viewStats` (~5331), `viewLibrary` (~5996), `viewLocalPlaylist` (~6328), `viewBrowse` (~6432).
- Pembangun HTML: `trackRowHTML`, `trackHeadHTML`, `quickCardHTML`, `carouselHTML`, `shelfHTML`, `likedCardHTML`, `emptyHTML`, `skeletonHTML`, `moodCardHTML`, `topResultHTML`, `searchResultsHTML`, `relatedSectionsHTML`, `recentSearchHTML`.
- Pemasangan event: `bindItems` (~4261, klik baris → now playing, dengan guard `.tbtn`), `bindCarousels`, `bindEmptyCtas`, `bindMoods`, `bindSearchChrome`, `bindOfflineRows`.
- `openNowPlayingAfterDelay` (~4387): di layar >= 1024 px panel kanan dibuka tertunda 350 ms setelah mini bar muncul (perbaikan L59), timer dibatalkan bila lagu berganti cepat.

## 6.8 Pencarian

- `viewSearch` + `bindSearchChrome`: autosuggest `/api/suggest`, debounce, filter (All/Songs/Videos/Albums/Artists/Playlists), kartu top result, hasil terkelompok, riwayat pencarian (`srec`, `pushRecentSearch`/`removeRecentSearch`).
- `searchResultsCache` + `_searchAbort` mencegah hasil balapan (race) saat mengetik cepat.
- `SEARCH_TYPE_LABEL` memetakan tipe hasil ke label Indonesia; `isSearchCard` memutuskan item bisa diklik sebagai kartu atau baris.

## 6.9 Library, playlist, impor

- Tab: Playlists, Favorites, Saved, History, Stats (`LIBRARY_LIMIT = 50`).
- CRUD playlist: `openCreatePlaylist`, `openRenamePlaylist`, `openDeletePlaylist`, `openAddToPlaylist` (~7251, 7292, 7332, 7359).
- Impor dari tautan YTM: `openImportForm`/`importFromLink` (~6139/6190) - mengekstrak `list=`/`playlistId` lalu `/api/browse`.
- Statistik: `viewStats` menghitung total putar, jam, artis teratas dari `stats`.

## 6.10 Lirik

- `loadLyrics` (~3280) → `/api/lyrics`; `parseLRC` (~3429) mengubah LRC menjadi bariswaktu; `renderLyrics`/`updateLyricHighlight` menandai baris aktif; tap baris = seek.
- `maybeRetryLyrics` (~3414) mencoba ulang bila hasil kosong; `fetchLyricsForDownload` dipakai sebelum mengunduh agar lirik ikut tersimpan.
- Overlay lirik besar: `openMainLyrics`/`closeMainLyrics`; header overlay disinkronkan `syncLyricsOverlayHeader`.

## 6.11 Unduhan

- `clickDownload` (~3925) → `downloadSong`/`downloadMp3` (`/api/download-start` + `/api/download-progress`, loader.to) untuk MP3; `downloadOffline` (~3935) memicu cache native.
- Nama berkas: `downloadFilename`; `activeDownloads` set mencegah unduhan ganda; `renderDownloadBadge`/`refreshDlBadges` menandai baris yang sudah offline.

## 6.12 Modal, pengaturan, keyboard

- `openSettingsModal(tab)` (~6999) menampung: mode stream (IFrame/VisionOS) via `NativeSettings`, cache audio on/off, batas maksimum lagu cache (`getCurrentMaxCached`/`applyMaxSongs`, 1..1000 dengan `MAX_SONGS_HARD_MAX = 1000`), jendela chunk (`chunk_window`, default 5, 1..200), izin notifikasi, optimasi baterai.
- Modal lain: bantuan (`openHelpModal`), backup/restore, kelola playlist, timer tidur (`openSleepTimer`, ~6731), menu lagu (`openSongMenu`), menu now playing (`openNowPlayingMore` + `syncNpMore`).
- `applySettingsEnvironment` (~6793) menyembunyikan opsi native-only saat berjalan di browser.
- Keyboard: Space play/pause, Shift+←/→ prev/next, Esc tutup now playing, L ganti tema, P widget, `?` bantuan.
- Tema: `toggleTheme` + `currentTheme`/`updateThemeIcon`, tersimpan di `theme`.

## 6.13 PiP & widget

- Dua bentuk: Document Picture-in-Picture (jika tersedia) dan widget mengambang berbasis DOM (`FW_CSS`, `widgetDocs`) yang bisa digeser (`enableDrag`) dengan posisi disimpan di `fw_pos`.
- `drawPipFrame`/`loadPipArt` (`~8194+`) menggambar kanvas PiP: artwork bulat (`roundRect`), judul, progress, baris lirik aktif (`currentLyricIndex`, `pipLyricLines`), dengan pembungkus teks (`wrapCanvasText`).
- `startSystemPip` (~8372) memakai PiP sistem Android lewat jembatan native; `showPipOnce`/`isHomePipOn` (`widget_home_pip`) mengatur tampil otomatis.

## 6.14 Mini bar & panel kanan

- Mini bar (~7477–7533): progress dapat diklik/di-drag (pointer events), plus tombol play, next, tambah antrean (`miniAddQueue`), tombol widget (`miniFloatBtn`), share (`npShare`).
- Panel kanan: `toggleRightPanel` (+ ikon `syncPanelToggleIcon`), tab antrean/lirik (`switchNPTab`), seek range now playing (~7791–7836).

# 7. Lapisan Android (Capacitor)

## 7.1 Paket & konfigurasi

- `appId`/`applicationId`: `com.dnialify.musicstream`; nama tampil "Dnialify Music Stream".
- WebView memuat `https://dnialify-music-stream.vercel.app` (bukan aset lokal) - kode web bisa diperbarui tanpa merilis APK baru. Konsekuensi: gate versi jadi kritis, dan aset di `assets/public/` hanya salinan/fallback.
- `androidScheme https`, `cleartext false`, `allowMixedContent true`, `captureInput true`; splash hitam 1200 ms.
- Manifest: `INTERNET`, `MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS`, `WAKE_LOCK`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE`, `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK`, `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, `BIND_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SERVICE`, `REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS`.
- Komponen: `MainActivity` (singleTask, `supportsPictureInPicture`, App Links autoVerify domain produksi), `PlaybackService` (foreground `mediaPlayback`, `stopWithTask=false`), `ExoMediaSessionService` (MediaSessionService, exported), `NotificationDuckService` (NotificationListener, ducking audio), `StreamTileService` (Quick Settings tile "Dnialify Stream"), `StreamSettingsActivity` (dialog, exported false), `VisionOsDiagActivity` (exported, layar diagnosa), `FileProvider`.

## 7.2 MainActivity (88.851 byte / 1.622 baris)

- `extends BridgeActivity`; mendaftarkan 7 interface JS di `onStart()` (~168–190): `NativePlayback` (PlaybackBridge), `Diagnostics`, `AppLogNative` (LogBridge), `NativeSettings`, `NativeFocus`, `AppInfo`, `NativeBattery`.
- **Masalah dikenal**: injeksi bridge di `onStart()` berlomba dengan pemuatan halaman. Bila halaman reload, `window.NativePlayback` bisa tidak lengkap → pemutaran jatuh ke IFrame. Ini akar "TEST B BLOCKED" pada `TODO.md`.
- Method `@JavascriptInterface` penting: `arm()`, `play(url,title,artist,artwork)`, `pause()`, seek/stop, `nativePlay`/`nativeStop`/`nativeSeek`, `currentTime`/`duration`, `speed`, `volume`/`setExtraVolume`/`setVolumeBoost`, `updateNotification`, `updateWebViewState(title,artist,artwork,isPlaying,positionMs,durationMs)`, `updateLyrics(prev,current,next)`, `updateLyricWindow(json,activeIdx)`, `cacheSong`, `getCachedSongs`, `getCachedSong`, `resumeCacheDownload`, `getStreamMode`/`setStreamMode`, `isAudioCacheOn`/`setAudioCache`, `getMaxCachedSongs`/`setMaxCachedSongs`, `setChunkWindow`, `log`/`logLine`/`drain`, `diagLog`, `getVersionName`, `isNotificationAccessGranted`/`openNotificationAccessSettings`, `isBatteryOptimizationIgnored`/`openBatteryOptimizationSettings`.
- Lifecycle: `onCreate`, `onStart`, `onResume`, `onPause`, `onStop`, `onRestart`, `onWindowFocusChanged`, `onTopResumedActivityChanged`, `onNewIntent`/`handleDeepLinkIntent`/`tryLoadPendingDeepLink`, `onBackPressed`, `onDestroy`, `onPictureInPictureModeChanged`.
- PiP native: `ensurePipNativeView`, `recalcPipDynamicScaling`, `updatePipNativeView`, `applyLyricLineStyle`, `loadArtworkNative`, `logPipNative` - lirik + artwork dirender sebagai view native di jendela PiP.
- `onConsoleMessage` meneruskan log WebView ke ring buffer native (`Log.java`).

## 7.3 NativeAudioEngine (120.464 byte / 2.652 baris)

- Kelas `final`; mesin audio utama APK; memakai `MediaPlayer`/ExoPlayer (via `ExoPlayerHolder`) memutar URL `googlevideo` hasil resolve.
- Alur: `play()` (~138) → `resolveAndStart()` → `resolve()` (~637) → `startPath()` (~804) / `startPathAt()` (~860) / `startUrl()` (~900); titik `MediaPlayer.start()` di ~811, 888–892, 915–916, 943.
- `onPrepared` menyetel durasi/posisi; `onCompletion` membedakan akhir asli (~981–998) vs akhir prematur (~1043) lalu memicu pemulihan.
- Pemulihan berlapis: L1 di resolver (`LOGIN_REQUIRED` → refresh visitor 1x → resolve ulang 1x), L2 soft-seek + verifikasi posisi (~1139–1194), L3 hard recovery 3x dengan sumber data sama (~1199–1265); gagal → `firePrematureError` → `failLocked(PREMATURE_COMPLETION)`.
- `failLocked` (~1045–1056) mengirim event ERROR ke JS dan mencatat `action` (dulu `iFrame`, FASE C → `skip`).
- Tidak ada cabang IFrame di engine; fallback iframe diputuskan di JS (`ev.state === "ERROR"` ~1332–1341; `startCurrent()` ~2190–2197; `STUCK_00_00` ~2804–2814; audio stall/error ~1376–1395).

## 7.4 Resolver & jaringan

- `VisionOsResolver` (18.876 byte / 410 baris): konteks VisionOS/`youtubei` untuk URL audio langsung; `LOGIN_REQUIRED` → `refreshVisitor()` sekali + resolve ulang sekali (~139–146, ~174, ~204–210, ~254–257); tetap gagal → lempar error.
- `VisionOsNet` (1.989 byte) klien HTTP ringan; `VisionOsCache` (5.801 byte) cache hasil resolve; `VisionOsLoopback` (7.959 byte) server loopback agar pemutar memakai URL lokal (mengakali batasan header/range).
- `VisionOsHarness` (79.703 byte / 1.710 baris): harness uji/diagnosa end-to-end (resolve → chunk → putar) untuk layar diag.
- `LocalStreamServer` (12.983 byte, `NanoHTTPD`): menyajikan chunk cache via HTTP + Range dari `127.0.0.1`.
- `OfflineInterceptClient` (2.395 byte, `WebViewClient`): intercept audio offline; dinonaktifkan `FeatureFlags.CACHE_INTERCEPT = false`.

## 7.5 Penyimpanan offline native

- `SongCache` (46.472 byte / 1.077 baris): unduh per chunk 1 MB (`ceil(total/1MB)`), tulis file, lanjutkan unduhan terputus, verifikasi, tandai `full`.
- `OfflineStorage` (6.266 byte) + `OfflineDatabase` (4.633 byte, `SQLiteOpenHelper`): metadata, status sumber, artwork, lirik, pin, waktu putar terakhir.
- `PlaybackService` (32.835 byte / 638 baris): foreground service, notifikasi media (artwork + kontrol), `MediaSession`, pemutaran latar, integrasi `ExoMediaSessionService`.
- `NotificationDuckService`: menurunkan volume saat notifikasi masuk lalu memulihkan (ducking).
- `StreamSettings`: prefs `visionos_stream_prefs` - `stream_mode`, `audio_cache`, `max_cached_songs` (default 100, clamp 1..1000), `pinned_video_ids`.
- `CacheEvents` (2.098 byte): callback progres cache ke JS. `StreamSettingsActivity`/`StreamTileService`/`VisionOsDiagActivity`: UI pengaturan/tile/diagnosa.

# 8. Offline, Cache, dan Background Playback

## 8.1 Rantai offline (hanya APK)

1. `getAudioUrl(videoId)` menghasilkan URL `googlevideo`; bila `signatureCipher` tak terpecahkan → null → IFrame → **tidak bisa offline**.
2. Native mengunduh `ceil(panjang/1MB)` segmen `seg_*.bin` ke `files/offline-beta/{songId}/{sourceId}/` (stable: `files/offline/...`), batas total 500 MB.
3. Metadata + artwork (w544, ~77 KB) + lirik (LRC/plain) disimpan agar kartu offline lengkap.
4. `offline_ready` = metadata + artwork + lirik ada + `source.status === "full"` + `stream_kind === "googlevideo"`.
5. Pemutaran offline dilayani `LocalStreamServer` (Range) atau `OfflineInterceptClient` (dimatikan).
6. URL bertanda tangan kedaluwarsa ~6 jam; 403 di tengah unduhan → resolve ulang + retry (unduhan bisa dilanjutkan).
7. Browser desktop/mobile belum mendukung offline (rencana SW + OPFS). Lagu iframe-only menampilkan "Tidak bisa offline" dan tombol simpan dimatikan.

## 8.2 UI offline di frontend

- `OfflineLib` (~2108) jembatan ke native: `getCachedSongs`, `getCachedSong`, `cacheSong`, `resumeCacheDownload`.
- `OffUI` (~5403) + `offPinnedMap`/`offPlayedMap`/`offLastPlayedAt` mengelola pin, urutan, "terakhir diputar".
- Fungsi: `getOfflineQueueList`, `playOfflineQueue`, `playOfflineSequential`, `playOfflineShuffle`, `shuffleOfflineArray`, `onOfflineRowClick`; mode pilih massal (`enterOfflineSelectMode`, `toggleOfflineRowSelection`, `selectAllOfflineRows`, `deleteOffCache`).
- Batas: `MAX_SONGS_HARD_MAX 1000` / `MAX_SONGS_FALLBACK 200`; modal `openMaxSongsModal` + `applyMaxSongs` memaksa pemangkasan saat limit diturunkan.
- `chunk_window` (default 5 menit, 1..200) mengatur agresivitas buffer chunk.

## 8.3 Background playback

- APK: `PlaybackService` foreground + `MediaSession` + `WAKE_LOCK` + `ExoMediaSessionService` (jalur produksi).
- Browser: Chromium menghentikan media saat halaman `hidden` kecuali `allow_background_video_playback_` aktif; karena itu direncanakan shell Chromium kustom (`docs/architecture.md`).
- Shell: fork Chromium + port patch Bare `0043` (background media), `0050` (halaman dilaporkan visible), `0051` (izin background dipertahankan); patch minimal proyek `patches/minimal/001..003`.
- Bukti uji (TEST A iframe): ytState 1, waktu 31→48→95 detik, `AudioPlaybackConfiguration` state `started`, notifikasi legacy 1001 PLAYING, `KEYCODE_SLEEP` 65 detik tetap kontinu 95→161 - jalur iframe + foreground service cukup di perangkat uji.
- `NotificationDuckService` mencegah audio melompat saat notifikasi masuk.

# 9. Versi, Rilis, CI/CD

## 9.1 Model versi

- `version` = versi native/APK (sekarang `3.1.0`); `webVersion` = versi aset web (sekarang `3.5.1`). Independen: web bisa naik tanpa APK baru.
- `scripts/inject-version.js` menyuntik versi ke `public/app.js`, `public/index.html`, `public/sw.js`, `public/manifest.json`; `sw.js` memakai `dnialify-assets-v<versi>` sehingga cache lama tersapu.
- `bump.js`/`bump-version.js`/`bump-web-version.js` menaikkan versi + commit; `release.js` menyiapkan rilis.
- `/api/app-version` → `{version, webVersion, appVersion, channel, assetCache, minVersion: "1.2.0", updatedAt}`, header `no-store`.
- Beta: `BUILD_CHANNEL=beta` (otomatis bila `webVersion` memuat `-beta`) → tulis `smw_beta_*`, DB `dnialify-offline-beta`, folder `files/offline-beta`, SW cache berbeda; beta melewati paksaan update.
- Promosi/rollback beta: `docs/beta-versioning.md`.

## 9.2 Riwayat versi terakhir

- `3.5.1` (L60): gate versi native menolak `n/a`/null/non-semver; commit `a54ae5d`.
- `3.5.0` (L59): panel kanan desktop dibuka tertunda 350 ms (transisi mini bar → panel mulus).
- `2.1.0-beta.1`: isolasi beta, single source of truth versi, audit Phase 0.5 (audio `googlevideo` progresif bukan HLS/DASH; strategi chunk 1 MB).
- `2.0.x`: boost volume native 100/200/300, perbaikan pemulihan putar.
- Native tetap `3.1.0` selama perubahan hanya menyentuh web.

## 9.3 CI

- `ci.yml`: push/PR `main` - `npm ci`, `lint`, `fmt:check`, `npm test`, lalu `node -e require("./server.js")` (smoke test modul).
- `android-build.yml`: APK debug saat `public/`,`android/`,`capacitor.config.json`,`package.json` berubah; Node 20 + JDK 17 + Android SDK; keystore debug dari `DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64`; `npx cap sync android`; `./gradlew assembleDebug`; verifikasi `aapt2`/`apksigner`/`keytool`; unggah artefak (14 hari).
- `build-apk.yml`: validasi sintaks patch Chromium; build penuh manual (`workflow_dispatch`) dengan depot_tools/fetch/GN/autoninja.
- `android.yml`: debug + rilis opsional (secret `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS`, `KEY_PASSWORD`).
- `build-capacitor-apk.yml`: `assembleDebug` + artefak 7 hari.
- Tidak ada deploy workflow: Vercel terhubung langsung ke repo (push ke `main` = deploy).

# 10. Observability, Risiko, dan Utang Teknis

## 10.1 Logging

- Frontend: `LogBuffer` + tag tetap (antara lain `DIAG_PLAY`, `ENGINE_SWITCH`, `MEDIA`, `PLAY`, `AUTONEXT`, `AUTONEXT_DIAG`, `NATIVE_STATE`, `NATIVE_START`, `PLAYBACK_JS`, `SKIP`, `FALLBACK`, `TRACE_01`..`TRACE_05B`, `TRACE_EMPTY`, `TRACE_IDX`, `TRACE_NOWIN`, `TRACE_DUP`, `TRACE_ERR`, `DIRTY_SET`, `SKIP_NOT_DIRTY`, `PUSH_DIRTY`, `LYRICS`, `PIN`, `PIP`, `PIP_DIAG`).
- Native: `Log.java` ring buffer + `AppLogNative.drain()`; `VisionOsDiagActivity` menampilkan status resolver/chunk.
- `public/diag.html` + `diag-hook.js` untuk uji audio latar di perangkat.

## 10.2 Risiko utama

| Risiko | Dampak | Mitigasi saat ini |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Bridge `NativePlayback` hilang setelah reload | semua lagu jatuh ke IFrame; offline mati | gate `isAndroidNative()`, deteksi `nativeActive`; akar (race `onStart`) belum dibereskan |
| `signatureCipher` tak terpecahkan | tak ada URL langsung → tak bisa offline | fallback IFrame + badge "Tidak bisa offline" |
| URL `googlevideo` kedaluwarsa ~6 jam | unduhan gagal 403 di tengah | resolve ulang + retry; unduhan dapat dilanjutkan |
| InnerTube berubah | metadata/lirik/stream rusak | konteks `WEB_REMIX` terpusat, parser defensif, beberapa penyedia lirik |
| WebView memuat web dari domain produksi | APK lama bisa memakai web baru yang tak kompatibel | `/api/app-version` + `minVersion` + gate L60 |
| `app.js` monolitik ~8.600 baris | sulit diuji/di-refactor | pemisahan bertahap; indeks simbol di dump ini |
| Cache 500 MB / 1000 lagu | penyimpanan penuh | batas `max_cached_songs` + pemangkasan saat limit turun |
| Rate limit 90/menit/IP | pengguna di belakang NAT bisa terblokir | header `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, 429 jelas |

## 10.3 Utang teknis (dari `TODO.md`)

- FASE B terblokir: `window.NativePlayback` hanya mengekspos `arm`/`updateWebViewState`/`nativeState` saat race terjadi → `startNativeTrack` tak terjangkau → semua IFrame. Perbaikan diinginkan: daftarkan bridge lebih awal (`onCreate` sebelum load) atau jembatan `postMessage`.
- FASE C (fallback `skip` + `skipStreak`) sudah dibuat tapi belum di-commit pada catatan terakhir.
- Unhook VisionOS dari `MediaPlayer` (prototipe 2.2.25) belum tuntas; `NativeAudioEngine` masih memakai `MediaPlayer` di beberapa titik.
- `FeatureFlags.CACHE_INTERCEPT = false` - intercept WebView untuk offline masih dimatikan.
- `package.json.main` menunjuk `index.js` yang tidak ada (warisan template).
- Offline di browser belum ada (SW + OPFS).

## 10.4 Cara verifikasi

```bash
npm install            # postinstall menjalankan patch-package
npm start              # http://localhost:3000
npm test               # node --test (unit parser)
npm run lint && npm run fmt:check
node scripts/generate-project-dump.js   # regenerasi dokumen ini
```

- Cek versi: `curl http://localhost:3000/api/app-version` → `webVersion` = `package.json`.
- Cek kesehatan: `/api/health` → `{ok:true,...}`.
- Uji tanpa YouTube: jalankan dengan `BLOCK_YOUTUBE=1`; pemutaran dari cache lokal harus tetap bekerja (buktikan nol dependensi YouTube saat offline).

```yaml
name: Android Build (Debug APK)

on:
  push:
    branches: [feature/apk-chromium-shell, main]
    paths:
      - "public/**"
      - "android/**"
      - "capacitor.config.json"
      - "package.json"
      - "package-lock.json"
      - ".github/workflows/android-build.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-debug:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD != '' && secrets.DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD || 'android' }}
      DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS != '' && secrets.DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS || 'androiddebugkey' }}
      DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD != '' && secrets.DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD || 'android' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Setup JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Setup Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Provide persistent debug keystore (for update-install)
        env:
          DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > android/app/debug.keystore
            echo "debug.keystore restored from secret $(wc -c < android/app/debug.keystore) bytes"
            ls -lh android/app/debug.keystore
          else
            echo "::warning::DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 not set — debug build will use ephemeral keystore and update-install will fail. Generate once (see docs) and set secret."
            # Generate deterministic debug keystore for this runner if missing (still ephemeral, but consistent password)
            if [ ! -f android/app/debug.keystore ]; then
              keytool -genkey -v -keystore android/app/debug.keystore -storepass android -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US" 2>&1 | tail -20 || true
            fi
          fi

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Sync Capacitor Android
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Verify APK (applicationId/versionCode/versionName/SHA-256)
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          set -e
          APK="app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          echo "APK exists: $(ls -lh "$APK")"
          # Locate aapt/aapt2 from SDK
          SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}"
          echo "SDK_ROOT=$SDK_ROOT"
          AAPT2="$(find "$SDK_ROOT/build-tools" -name "aapt2" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
          AAPT="$(find "$SDK_ROOT/build-tools" -name "aapt" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
          APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK_ROOT/build-tools" -name "apksigner" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
          echo "found aapt2=$AAPT2"
          echo "found aapt=$AAPT"
          echo "found apksigner=$APKSIGNER"
          echo "--- applicationId / versionCode / versionName ---"
          if [ -n "$AAPT2" ]; then
            "$AAPT2" dump badging "$APK" 2>&1 | grep -E "package:" || true
          elif [ -n "$AAPT" ]; then
            "$AAPT" dump badging "$APK" 2>&1 | grep -E "package:" || true
          else
            echo "::warning::aapt/aapt2 not found, fallback to apkanalyzer"
            APKANL=""; [ -n "$SDK_ROOT" ] && APKANL="$(find "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools" -name "apkanalyzer" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
            if [ -n "$APKANL" ]; then "$APKANL" manifest version-code "$APK" 2>&1 || true; "$APKANL" manifest version-name "$APK" 2>&1 || true; fi
          fi
          echo "--- SHA-256 signing certificate ---"
          if [ -n "$APKSIGNER" ]; then
            "$APKSIGNER" verify --print-certs "$APK" 2>&1 || true
          fi
          # keytool fallback (always available)
          echo "--- keytool fallback ---"
          keytool -printcert -jarfile "$APK" 2>&1 | grep -E "Owner|SHA256|Valid" || true
          echo "--- debug keystore used (if persistent) ---"
          if [ -f "app/debug.keystore" ]; then
            keytool -list -v -keystore "app/debug.keystore" -storepass "${DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-android}" 2>&1 | grep -E "Alias|SHA256|Valid" | head -n 20 || true
          else
            echo "app/debug.keystore not found (ephemeral Gradle debug keystore was used)"
          fi

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-debug
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
```

```yaml
name: Build APK
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, feature/apk-chromium-shell]
    paths:
      - "public/**"
      - "android/**"
      - "capacitor.config.json"
      - "package.json"
      - ".github/workflows/android.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
      KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - run: npm ci

      - name: Provide persistent debug keystore
        env:
          DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > android/app/debug.keystore
          else
            keytool -genkey -v -keystore android/app/debug.keystore -storepass android \
              -alias androiddebugkey -keypass android -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 \
              -validity 10000 -dname "CN=Android Debug,O=Android,C=US"
          fi

      - name: Sync Capacitor Android project
        run: npx cap sync android

      - name: Build installable Debug APK
        run: |
          cd android
          chmod +x gradlew
          ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Verify installable APK
        working-directory: android
        run: |
          APK="app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"
          test -s "$APK"
          SDK_ROOT="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$ANDROID_HOME}"
          APKSIGNER="$(find "$SDK_ROOT/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | head -n1)"
          "$APKSIGNER" verify --verbose "$APK"

      - name: Upload installable APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dnialify-installable-debug-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          retention-days: 14

      # Optional: Build release APK if release keystore secrets are set
      - name: Decode Keystore (if secret exists)
        if: ${{ env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}
        run: |
          echo "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > android/app/release.keystore
          ls -lh android/app/release.keystore

      - name: Build Release APK (signed)
        if: ${{ env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}
        run: |
          cd android
          # inject signing config via gradle properties
          echo "MYAPP_RELEASE_STORE_FILE=release.keystore" >> gradle.properties
          echo "MYAPP_RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS" >> gradle.properties
          echo "MYAPP_RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" >> gradle.properties
          echo "MYAPP_RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASSWORD" >> gradle.properties
          ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Release APK
        if: ${{ env.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dnialify-release-apk
          path: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
          retention-days: 30
```

```yaml
name: Build MusicStream APK (Chromium Shell)

on:
  push:
    branches: [feature/apk-chromium-shell]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      full_build:
        description: 'Run full autoninja (needs 100GB disk, will fail on GH free runner)'
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 300
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Validate minimal patches (no Chromium fetch, GH free runner only 73G)
        run: |
          echo "Checking patch syntax (git apply --check) without full Chromium checkout"
          for p in patches/minimal/*.patch; do echo "=== $p ==="; git apply --check "$p" 2>&1 || echo "NOTE: $p needs Chromium tree (expected missing file error, not corrupt)"; done
          echo "Patch headers:"
          grep -H "^diff --git" patches/minimal/*.patch || true
          echo "All 3 minimal patches present: $(ls -1 patches/minimal/*.patch | wc -l) (expected 3)"

      - name: Setup depot_tools (only for full_build)
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          git clone https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/tools/depot_tools.git /tmp/depot_tools
          echo "/tmp/depot_tools" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Free disk (only for full_build, Chromium needs >100G)
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          df -h
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL /usr/local/.ghcup /usr/local/share/boost /opt/hostedtoolcache 2>&1 | head -20 || true
          sudo docker image prune --all --force 2>&1 | head -20 || true
          sudo rm -rf /tmp/chromium/.cipd 2>&1 | head || true
          sudo apt-get clean
          df -h

      - name: Cache Chromium
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: /tmp/chromium
          key: chromium-${{ hashFiles('docs/architecture.md') }}

      - name: Fetch Chromium (shallow, only for full_build)
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/chromium && cd /tmp/chromium
          df -h
          if [ ! -f .gclient ]; then
            fetch --nohooks --nohistory android
          else
            echo ".gclient exists, syncing..."
            gclient sync --nohooks --with_branch_heads --with_tags --no-history
          fi
          df -h
          du -sh /tmp/chromium 2>&1 | head -20 || true

      - name: Apply minimal patches
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          cd /tmp/chromium/src
          for p in $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/patches/minimal/*.patch; do echo "Applying $p"; git apply "$p" || (echo "FAILED $p" && exit 1); done
          git diff --stat

      - name: GN gen (validate patches)
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          cd /tmp/chromium/src
          gn gen out/Release --args='target_os="android" target_cpu="arm64" is_debug=false is_official_build=false' || echo "gn gen failed (expected if hooks not run)"
          ls -lh out/Release 2>&1 | head -30 || true

      - name: Build APK (full, needs self-hosted 100G)
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        run: |
          cd /tmp/chromium/src
          autoninja -C out/Release chrome_public_apk
          ls -lh out/Release/apks/

      - name: Upload APK
        if: ${{ inputs.full_build }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: MusicStream-apk
          path: /tmp/chromium/src/out/Release/apks/*.apk
```

```gradle
apply plugin: 'com.android.application'

def computedVersionCode = {
    // Monotonic versionCode: sync with package.json + CI run number
    // Local build must be > last installed 130 so adb install -r works
    def runNum = System.getenv("GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER")?.toInteger() ?: 0
    def base = 146 // floor: device has 145 (FASE1 debug), must be 146
    def code = base + runNum
    return code
}()
def computedVersionName = {
    // Single source of truth: package.json version (2.1.0-beta.1)
    def pkgFile = file("../../package.json")
    def pkgVersion = "2.1.0-beta.1"
    try {
        def parsed = new groovy.json.JsonSlurper().parse(pkgFile)
        if (parsed.version) pkgVersion = parsed.version
    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    def runNum = System.getenv("GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER")?.toString() ?: ""
    if (runNum) return pkgVersion + "-build." + runNum
    return pkgVersion
}()

android {
    namespace "com.dnialify.musicstream"
    compileSdk rootProject.ext.compileSdkVersion
    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "com.dnialify.musicstream"
        minSdkVersion rootProject.ext.minSdkVersion
        targetSdkVersion rootProject.ext.targetSdkVersion
        versionCode computedVersionCode
        versionName computedVersionName
        testInstrumentationRunner "androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner"
        aaptOptions {
             // Files and dirs to omit from the packaged assets dir, modified to accommodate modern web apps.
             // Default: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/282e181b58cf72b6ca770dc7ca5f91f135444502/tools/aapt/AaptAssets.cpp#61
            ignoreAssetsPattern '!.svn:!.git:!.ds_store:!*.scc:.*:!CVS:!thumbs.db:!picasa.ini:!*~'
        }
    }
    signingConfigs {
        debug {
            // Persistent debug keystore for update-install; if android/app/debug.keystore exists use it,
            // else Gradle generates ephemeral one (will warn). Workflow should provide it via secret.
            def debugStore = file('debug.keystore')
            if (debugStore.exists()) {
                storeFile debugStore
                storePassword System.getenv("DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD") ?: "android"
                keyAlias System.getenv("DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS") ?: "androiddebugkey"
                keyPassword System.getenv("DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD") ?: "android"
            }
        }
        release {
            def releaseStore = file('release.keystore')
            if (releaseStore.exists()) {
                storeFile releaseStore
                storePassword System.getenv("KEYSTORE_PASSWORD") ?: System.getenv("DEBUG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD") ?: "android"
                keyAlias System.getenv("KEY_ALIAS") ?: System.getenv("DEBUG_KEY_ALIAS") ?: "androiddebugkey"
                keyPassword System.getenv("KEY_PASSWORD") ?: System.getenv("DEBUG_KEY_PASSWORD") ?: "android"
            }
        }
    }
    buildTypes {
        debug {
            signingConfig signingConfigs.debug
            // Ensure debug uses persistent store if available
        }
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
            proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
            if (file('release.keystore').exists()) {
                signingConfig signingConfigs.release
            }
        }
    }
}

repositories {
    flatDir{
        dirs '../capacitor-cordova-android-plugins/src/main/libs', 'libs'
    }
}

dependencies {
    implementation fileTree(include: ['*.jar'], dir: 'libs')
    implementation "androidx.appcompat:appcompat:$androidxAppCompatVersion"
    implementation "androidx.coordinatorlayout:coordinatorlayout:$androidxCoordinatorLayoutVersion"
    implementation "androidx.core:core-splashscreen:$coreSplashScreenVersion"
    implementation "androidx.webkit:webkit:$androidxWebkitVersion"
    implementation project(':capacitor-android')
    implementation "androidx.media:media:1.7.0"
    // Socket 1 (FASE 2): media3 deps only, no code wire yet. 1.4.1 = versi
    // integrasi Exo sebelumnya (compileSdk 34, minSdk 22 OK).
    implementation "androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.4.1"
    implementation "androidx.media3:media3-session:1.4.1"
    implementation "androidx.media3:media3-ui:1.4.1"
    implementation "org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd:2.3.1"
    testImplementation "junit:junit:$junitVersion"
    testImplementation "org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc:3.45.0.0"
    testImplementation "org.robolectric:robolectric:4.11.1"
    androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.ext:junit:$androidxJunitVersion"
    androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.espresso:espresso-core:$androidxEspressoCoreVersion"
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.media.AudioManager;
import android.media.AudioPlaybackConfiguration;
import android.media.audiofx.LoudnessEnhancer;
import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.util.Log;
import android.webkit.WebChromeClient;
import android.webkit.WebSettings;
import android.webkit.WebView;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ScrollView;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.view.Gravity;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * POC terisolasi untuk eksperimen native gain YouTube iframe.
 * TIDAK MEMODIFIKASI MainActivity.java / public/app.js / server.js
 * Tujuan: jawab 3 pertanyaan opencode.txt:
 * 1. Apakah YT iframe muncul sebagai AudioPlaybackConfiguration?
 * 2. Bisa dapat session ID?
 * 3. Apakah LoudnessEnhancer(sessionId) benar menaikkan volume?
 *
 * Cara pakai:
 * adb shell am start -n com.dnialify.musicstream/.PocVolumeActivity
 * Lihat logcat: adb logcat -s PocVolume:D
 */
public class PocVolumeActivity extends Activity {
    private static final String TAG = "PocVolume";
    private WebView webView;
    private TextView logView;
    private AudioManager audioManager;
    private AudioManager.AudioPlaybackCallback playbackCallback;
    private int webAudioSessionId = 0;
    private LoudnessEnhancer enhancer;

    // Reflection helpers: these APIs are absent from compileSdk 34 but may exist at runtime.
    private static String clientPkg(AudioPlaybackConfiguration c) {
        try {
            Object v = AudioPlaybackConfiguration.class.getMethod("getClientPackageName").invoke(c);
            return v != null ? String.valueOf(v) : null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static int audioSession(AudioPlaybackConfiguration c) {
        try {
            Object v = AudioPlaybackConfiguration.class.getMethod("getAudioSessionId").invoke(c);
            return v instanceof Number ? ((Number) v).intValue() : -1;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    private void log(String msg) {
        Log.d(TAG, msg);
        if (logView != null) {
            runOnUiThread(() -> {
                logView.append(msg + "\n");
                // auto scroll handled by ScrollView
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);

        // UI: vertical LinearLayout
        LinearLayout root = new LinearLayout(this);
        root.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        root.setLayoutParams(new ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT));

        // WebView
        webView = new WebView(this);
        WebSettings ws = webView.getSettings();
        ws.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
        ws.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
        ws.setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(false);
        ws.setAllowFileAccess(true);
        webView.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient());
        // simple YT iframe page
        String html = "<html><body style='margin:0;background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif'>" +
                "<h3 style='padding:8px'>POC YT iframe</h3>" +
                "<iframe width='100%' height='220' src='https://www.youtube.com/embed/M7lc1UVf-VE?autoplay=1&enablejsapi=1' frameborder='0' allow='autoplay; encrypted-media' allowfullscreen></iframe>" +
                "<p style='padding:8px;color:#999'>Play video, lalu cek log session. Tap tombol gain.</p>" +
                "</body></html>";
        webView.loadDataWithBaseURL("https://www.youtube.com", html, "text/html", "utf-8", null);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams webParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1.0f);
        root.addView(webView, webParams);

        // Buttons row
        LinearLayout btnRow = new LinearLayout(this);
        btnRow.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        btnRow.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER);
        btnRow.setPadding(8,8,8,8);
        int[] levels = {100, 150, 200, 250, 300};
        for (int lv : levels) {
            Button b = new Button(this);
            b.setText(lv + "%");
            b.setTag(lv);
            b.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                int level = (int) v.getTag();
                applyGain(level);
            });
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams bp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1.0f);
            bp.setMargins(4,0,4,0);
            btnRow.addView(b, bp);
        }
        root.addView(btnRow, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        // Log view
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        logView = new TextView(this);
        logView.setTextSize(11f);
        logView.setPadding(8,8,8,8);
        logView.setText("POC Volume log:\n");
        scroll.addView(logView);
        LinearLayout.LayoutParams scrollParams = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 400);
        root.addView(scroll, scrollParams);

        // Refresh button
        Button refreshBtn = new Button(this);
        refreshBtn.setText("Refresh session scan");
        refreshBtn.setOnClickListener(v -> scanNow());
        root.addView(refreshBtn, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT));

        setContentView(root);

        // AudioManager callback API >=24 (prompt minta >=24)
        audioManager = (AudioManager) getSystemService(AUDIO_SERVICE);
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            playbackCallback = new AudioManager.AudioPlaybackCallback() {
                @Override
                public void onPlaybackConfigChanged(List<AudioPlaybackConfiguration> configs) {
                    log("=== onPlaybackConfigChanged configs=" + configs.size() + " ===");
                    for (AudioPlaybackConfiguration c : configs) {
                        try {
                            String pkg = clientPkg(c);
                            // usage via AudioAttributes
                            int usage = c.getAudioAttributes().getUsage();
                            int session = -1;
                            try { session = audioSession(c); } catch (Exception e) { log("getAudioSessionId ex " + e); }
                            log("config pkg=" + pkg + " usage=" + usage + " sessionId=" + session);
                            // heuristic: WebView YT likely USAGE_MEDIA (1) and package = us
                            if (pkg != null && pkg.equals(getPackageName()) && usage == 1 && session != 0) {
                                if (session != webAudioSessionId) {
                                    log(">> CANDIDATE WebView sessionId=" + session + " (pkg match USAGE_MEDIA)");
                                    webAudioSessionId = session;
                                    // jangan auto-create enhancer di sini, biar tombol yang test, tapi log
                                    log("webAudioSessionId updated to " + webAudioSessionId);
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            log("config parse ex " + e);
                        }
                    }
                    if (webAudioSessionId == 0) {
                        log("No WebView session found yet (webAudioSessionId==0)");
                    }
                }
            };
            try {
                audioManager.registerAudioPlaybackCallback(playbackCallback, null);
                log("registerAudioPlaybackCallback OK (API " + Build.VERSION.SDK_INT + ")");
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log("registerAudioPlaybackCallback FAILED " + e);
            }
        } else {
            log("API <24, AUDIO_PLAYBACK_CALLBACK not available. Need API 24+ for POC. Current=" + Build.VERSION.SDK_INT);
        }

        log("POC onCreate done. Play YT video, then tap Refresh or wait for callback.");
        log("webAudioSessionId initial=" + webAudioSessionId);
    }

    private void scanNow() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            // API 26+ getActivePlaybackConfigurations polling
            try {
                AudioManager am = (AudioManager) getSystemService(AUDIO_SERVICE);
                List<AudioPlaybackConfiguration> list = am.getActivePlaybackConfigurations();
                log("=== scanNow getActivePlaybackConfigurations size=" + list.size() + " ===");
                for (AudioPlaybackConfiguration c : list) {
                    try {
                        String pkg = clientPkg(c);
                        int usage = c.getAudioAttributes().getUsage();
                        int session = audioSession(c);
                        log("scan pkg=" + pkg + " usage=" + usage + " sessionId=" + session);
                        if (pkg != null && pkg.equals(getPackageName()) && usage == 1 && session != 0) {
                            log(">> scan CANDIDATE sessionId=" + session);
                            webAudioSessionId = session;
                        }
                    } catch (Exception e) { log("scan ex " + e); }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) { log("scanNow ex " + e); }
        } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
            log("scanNow: API 24-25, rely on callback only, no getActivePlaybackConfigurations (needs 26).");
        } else {
            log("scanNow: API <24 not supported");
        }
        log("Current webAudioSessionId=" + webAudioSessionId);
    }

    private void applyGain(int level) {
        // definisi multiplier per opencode.txt
        double multiplier = level / 100.0;
        double gainDb = 0;
        if (level > 100) {
            gainDb = 20.0 * Math.log10(multiplier);
        }
        int targetMb = (int) (gainDb * 100);
        log("=== applyGain level=" + level + "% multiplier=" + multiplier + " gainDb=" + String.format("%.2f", gainDb) + " targetMb=" + targetMb + " sessionId=" + webAudioSessionId + " ===");

        if (webAudioSessionId == 0) {
            log("FAIL: webAudioSessionId==0 invalid, cannot create LoudnessEnhancer. Play video first, wait for session, tap Refresh.");
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Reuse satu instance untuk session yang sama (opencode.txt: jangan banyak instance)
            if (enhancer != null) {
                try {
                    // cek apakah session masih sama, jika beda, release dan buat baru
                    // LoudnessEnhancer tidak ada getAudioSessionId, jadi simpan manual
                    // Untuk POC sederhana, release jika session berubah (deteksi via webAudioSessionId change)
                    // Di sini kita cek jika enhancer sudah ada dan sessionId sebelumnya beda (track via field)
                    // Simplifikasi: jika enhancer ada, coba setEnabled false, release jika sessionId berubah (kita tidak tau old session, jadi release tiap ganti session)
                    // Untuk POC ini, jika enhancer sudah ada dan level==100, disable; jika sessionId sama, reuse
                    // Kita simpan lastSessionId
                } catch (Exception ignore) {}
            }
            // Jika enhancer null atau sessionId berubah, buat baru
            // Untuk POC: selalu reuse jika enhancer != null, tapi jika sessionId berbeda dari saat enhancer dibuat, release
            // Simpan lastSession di tag enhancer via reflection? Simplifikasi: release dan buat baru tiap apply jika sessionId != last
            // Untuk POC ini, kita buat baru jika enhancer == null
            if (enhancer == null) {
                log("Creating LoudnessEnhancer(sessionId=" + webAudioSessionId + ")");
                enhancer = new LoudnessEnhancer(webAudioSessionId);
                log("LoudnessEnhancer created OK sessionId=" + webAudioSessionId);
            } else {
                log("Reusing existing LoudnessEnhancer for sessionId=" + webAudioSessionId);
            }
            log("Calling setTargetGain(" + targetMb + " mB) for level " + level + "%");
            enhancer.setTargetGain(targetMb);
            boolean enable = level > 100;
            enhancer.setEnabled(enable);
            log("setEnabled(" + enable + ") OK. getEnabled()=" + enhancer.getEnabled() + " hasControl=" + isEnhancerHasControl(enhancer));
            log("SUCCESS: gain " + gainDb + "dB (" + targetMb + " mB) applied to session " + webAudioSessionId + " enabled=" + enable);
            log("TEST: Dengarkan apakah volume YT iframe benar berubah 100→" + level + "%");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log("EXCEPTION LoudnessEnhancer sessionId=" + webAudioSessionId + " level=" + level + " ex=" + e + " msg=" + e.getMessage());
            e.printStackTrace();
            // release on failure
            try { if (enhancer != null) { enhancer.release(); enhancer = null; } } catch (Exception ignore) {}
            log("Enhancer released after exception");
        }
    }

    private boolean isEnhancerHasControl(LoudnessEnhancer e) {
        try {
            // hasControl() exists API 19+
            return e.getEnabled(); // fallback, hasControl is hidden? use getEnabled as proxy
        } catch (Exception ex) { return false; }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        log("onDestroy release enhancer session=" + webAudioSessionId);
        try {
            if (playbackCallback != null && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                AudioManager am = (AudioManager) getSystemService(AUDIO_SERVICE);
                am.unregisterAudioPlaybackCallback(playbackCallback);
                log("unregisterAudioPlaybackCallback OK");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) { log("unregister ex " + e); }
        try {
            if (enhancer != null) {
                enhancer.setEnabled(false);
                enhancer.release();
                enhancer = null;
                log("enhancer release OK");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) { log("enhancer release ex " + e); }
        if (webView != null) {
            webView.destroy();
        }
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}
```

```javascript
// Reference: https://github.com/brave/adblock-resources/blob/master/resources/brave-video-bg-play.js
// Adapted only for stock Android WebView. YouTube remains video source.
(function(){
  const h = window.location.hostname;
  const isYoutube = /(?:^|\.)youtube(?:-nocookie)?\.com$/.test(h);
  const isMobileYoutube = h === 'm.youtube.com';
  const isDesktopYoutube = isYoutube && !isMobileYoutube;
  const isAndroid = /Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  if (isAndroid || !isDesktopYoutube) {
    try { Object.defineProperties(document, { hidden:{value:false}, visibilityState:{value:'visible'} }); } catch(e) {}
  }
  window.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(e){ e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);
  if (isYoutube) {
    function refreshLact() { try { window._lact = Date.now(); } catch(e) {} }
    function wait() {
      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(window, '_lact')) {
        refreshLact();
        window.setInterval(refreshLact, 5 * 60 * 1000);
      } else window.setTimeout(wait, 1000);
    }
    wait();
  }
})();
```

```javascript
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'app_log_buffer_v1';

  const JS_TAG_WHITELIST = new Set([

    'LocalStreamServer', 'VisionOsResolver',
    'VisionOsNet', 'VisionOsLoopback', 'OfflineInterceptClient',
    'VisionOsHarness', 'DnialifyDiag',
    // Always
    'ERROR', 'WARN'
  ]);

  let entries = [];
  let persistQueued = false;

  function shouldPush(tag, msg) {
    if (JS_TAG_WHITELIST.has(tag)) return true;
    if (/ERROR|WARN|FAILED|EXCEPTION/i.test(msg)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function persist() {
    persistQueued = false;
    try {
      const tail = entries.slice(-STORAGE_TAIL);
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(tail));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore quota errors */ }
  }

  function schedulePersist() {
    if (persistQueued) return;
    persistQueued = true;
    setTimeout(persist, 1500);
  }

  function load() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) entries = parsed;
      }
    } catch (e) { entries = []; }
  }

  function push(tag, msg) {
    const t = String(tag || 'APP');
    const m = String(msg == null ? '' : msg);
    if (!shouldPush(t, m)) return;
    entries.push({ ts: Date.now(), tag: t, msg: m });
    if (entries.length > MAX_ENTRIES) {
      entries.splice(0, entries.length - MAX_ENTRIES);
    }
    schedulePersist();
  }

  function pushRaw(tsString, tag, msg) {
    const t = String(tag || 'NATIVE');
    const m = String(msg == null ? '' : msg);
    if (!shouldPush(t, m)) return;
    let ts = Date.now();
    if (tsString) {
      const parsed = Date.parse(String(tsString).replace(' ', 'T'));
      if (!isNaN(parsed)) ts = parsed;
    }
    entries.push({ ts: ts, tag: t, msg: m });
    if (entries.length > MAX_ENTRIES) {
      entries.splice(0, entries.length - MAX_ENTRIES);
    }
    schedulePersist();
  }

  function all() { return entries.slice(); }

  function clear() {
    entries = [];
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function filter(opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    const fromTs = opts.fromTs || 0;
    const toTs = opts.toTs || Infinity;
    const tags = opts.tags;
    const tagSet = tags && tags.length
      ? (tags instanceof Set ? tags : new Set(tags))
      : null;
    const search = opts.search ? String(opts.search).toLowerCase() : null;
    return entries.filter(function (e) {
      if (e.ts < fromTs || e.ts > toTs) return false;
      if (tagSet && !tagSet.has(e.tag)) return false;
      if (search && e.msg.toLowerCase().indexOf(search) < 0) return false;
      return true;
    });
  }

  load();
  return {
    push: push,
    pushRaw: pushRaw,
    all: all,
    clear: clear,
    filter: filter,
    MAX_ENTRIES: MAX_ENTRIES
  };
})();
window.LogBuffer = LogBuffer;

/* ========== Console -> LogBuffer hook ========== */
(function () {
  const origLog = console.log.bind(console);
  const origWarn = console.warn.bind(console);
  const origError = console.error.bind(console);

  function parseTag(msg) {
    const m = String(msg).match(/^\s*\[([A-Z_0-9]+)\]/);
    return m ? m[1] : 'APP';
  }

  function joinArgs(args) {
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
      const a = args[i];
      if (a instanceof Error) out.push(a.message);
      else if (typeof a === 'object' && a !== null) {
        try { out.push(JSON.stringify(a)); } catch (e) { out.push(String(a)); }
      } else out.push(String(a));
    }
    return out.join(' ');
  }

  console.log = function () {
    const msg = joinArgs(arguments);
    try { LogBuffer.push(parseTag(msg), msg); } catch (e) {}
    return origLog.apply(null, arguments);
  };
  console.warn = function () {
    const msg = joinArgs(arguments);
    try { LogBuffer.push(parseTag(msg) || 'WARN', msg); } catch (e) {}
    return origWarn.apply(null, arguments);
  };
  console.error = function () {
    const msg = joinArgs(arguments);
    try { LogBuffer.push(parseTag(msg) || 'ERROR', msg); } catch (e) {}
    return origError.apply(null, arguments);
  };
})();

/* ========== Native -> LogBuffer poller ========== */
(function () {
  let emptyStreak = 0;
  function poll() {
    try {
      if (window.AppLogNative && typeof AppLogNative.drain === 'function') {
        const lines = AppLogNative.drain();
        if (lines && lines.length > 0) {
          emptyStreak = 0;
          const arr = lines.split('\n');
          for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
            const raw = arr[i];
            if (!raw) continue;
            const m = raw.match(/^\[([^\]]+)\]\s+\[([A-Z])\/([^\]]*)\]\s+(.*)$/);
            if (m) {
              LogBuffer.pushRaw(m[1], m[3] || 'NATIVE', m[4]);
            } else {
              LogBuffer.pushRaw(null, 'NATIVE', raw);
            }
          }
        } else {
          emptyStreak++;
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    const delay = emptyStreak > 30 ? 5000 : 2000;
    setTimeout(poll, delay);
  }
  setTimeout(poll, 1500);
})();

/* ========== Logs tab UI ========== */
(function () {
  const PLAYBACK_TAGS = [
    // JS tags
    'NATIVE_STATE', 'NATIVE_CMD', 'ENGINE', 'SONG',
    'AUTONEXT_DIAG', 'PIP', 'DIAG_PLAY',
    'CACHE', 'LSS', 'WEBVIEW_JS',
    // Native tags
    'DnialifyVisionOS', 'NativeAudioEngine', 'NAE', 'PlaybackService',
    'SongCache', 'VisionOsCache', 'CacheEvents',
    'LocalStreamServer', 'VisionOsResolver',
    'VisionOsNet', 'VisionOsLoopback', 'OfflineInterceptClient',
    'VisionOsHarness', 'DnialifyDiag',
    // Native prefix (fallback)
    'NATIVE'
  ];

  function pad(n, w) { return String(n).padStart(w, '0'); }
  function fmtTs(ms) {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth()+1,2) + '-' + pad(d.getDate(),2)
      + ' ' + pad(d.getHours(),2) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes(),2) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds(),2)
      + '.' + pad(d.getMilliseconds(),3);
  }
  function toLocalInputValue(ms) {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth()+1,2) + '-' + pad(d.getDate(),2)
      + 'T' + pad(d.getHours(),2) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes(),2);
  }
  function fromInputValue(v) {
    if (!v) return null;
    const t = Date.parse(v);
    return isNaN(t) ? null : t;
  }
  function currentFilter() {
    const preset = (document.getElementById('log-preset') || {}).value || 'playback';
    const from = fromInputValue((document.getElementById('log-from') || {}).value);
    const to = fromInputValue((document.getElementById('log-to') || {}).value);
    const search = ((document.getElementById('log-search') || {}).value || '').trim();
    let tags = null;
    if (preset === 'playback') tags = PLAYBACK_TAGS;
    else if (preset === 'errors') tags = ['ERROR', 'WARN', 'E'];
    return { fromTs: from || 0, toTs: to || Infinity, tags: tags, search: search || null };
  }
  function render() {
    const pre = document.getElementById('log-view');
    const cnt = document.getElementById('log-count');
    if (!pre || !cnt) return;
    const list = LogBuffer.filter(currentFilter());
    const tail = list.slice(-2000);
    pre.textContent = tail.map(function (e) {
      return '[' + fmtTs(e.ts) + '] [' + e.tag + '] ' + e.msg;
    }).join('\n');
    cnt.textContent = list.length + ' lines' + (list.length > 2000 ? ' (showing last 2000)' : '');
    pre.scrollTop = pre.scrollHeight;
  }
  function refreshPresets() {
    const fromEl = document.getElementById('log-from');
    const toEl = document.getElementById('log-to');
    if (fromEl && !fromEl.value) fromEl.value = toLocalInputValue(Date.now() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
    if (toEl && !toEl.value) toEl.value = toLocalInputValue(Date.now());
  }
  function textOut() {
    return LogBuffer.filter(currentFilter()).map(function (e) {
      return '[' + fmtTs(e.ts) + '] [' + e.tag + '] ' + e.msg;
    }).join('\n');
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function (ev) {
    const id = ev.target && ev.target.id;
    if (id === 'log-copy') {
      const txt = textOut();
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
      else {
        const ta = document.createElement('textarea'); ta.value = txt; document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();
        try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {} ta.remove();
      }
    } else if (id === 'log-share') {
      const txt = textOut();
      try {
        const file = new File([txt], 'app-log.txt', { type: 'text/plain' });
        if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files: [file] })) navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'App Log' }).catch(function(){});
        else if (navigator.share) navigator.share({ title: 'App Log', text: txt }).catch(function(){});
        else if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);
      } catch (e) {}
    } else if (id === 'log-clear') {
      if (window.confirm('Clear all logs?')) { LogBuffer.clear(); render(); }
    }
  });
  ['log-preset','log-from','log-to','log-search'].forEach(function (id) {
    document.addEventListener('change', function (ev) { if (ev.target && ev.target.id === id) render(); });
    document.addEventListener('input', function (ev) { if (ev.target && ev.target.id === id) render(); });
  });
  setInterval(render, 2000);
  setTimeout(function () { refreshPresets(); render(); }, 500);
})();
```
