  #nowplaying #np-quality span { display: inline; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
  #nowplaying #np-lyric-preview { max-width: none; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; }
  body.np-open.has-player #nowplaying { margin-bottom: var(--player-h); }
}

/* ---------- responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 980px){
  .pb-right { display: none; }
  #miniplayer { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; }
  .tb-search { max-width: 280px; }
}
@media (max-width: 860px){
  #app { padding: 0; gap: 0; }
  #sidebar { display: none; }
  #topbar { display: none; }
  #nav-mobile{
    display: grid !important;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5,1fr);
    position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: var(--navm-h);
    background: var(--main-bg); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 8%,transparent);
    z-index: 30; padding: 6px 0 8px;
  }
  #nav-mobile .nav-item{
    flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 2px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600;
    justify-content: center; align-items: center; color: var(--muted);
  }
  #nav-mobile .nav-item.active{ color: var(--text); }
  #nav-mobile .nav-item .ic{ width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  #nav-mobile .nav-item span{ font-size: 9.5px; letter-spacing: .02em; }
  #main { border-radius: 0; }
  :root { --player-h: 64px; }
  .np-handle { display: block; }
  #miniplayer {
    left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: calc(var(--navm-h) + 8px); height: 64px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-hover) 92%, var(--accent) 8%);
    border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; gap: 10px;
    border: none; backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  }
  body.has-player #main { margin-bottom: 0; padding-bottom: calc(var(--navm-h) + 92px); }
  body.float-mode.has-player #main { padding-bottom: calc(var(--navm-h) + 16px); }
  .pb-left { flex: 1; }
  #mini-art { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
  .pb-center { flex-direction: row; max-width: none; width: auto; }
  .pb-seek { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; }
  .pb-seek span { display: none; }
  .pb-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 0 0 9px 9px; }
  .pb-buttons { gap: 8px; }
  #mini-shuffle, #mini-repeat { display: none; }
  .play-circle { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
  #view { padding: 18px 16px 30px; }
  .sr-top { flex-direction: row; gap: 14px; padding: 12px; }
  .sr-top img, .art-ph-sr { width: 92px; height: 92px; }
  .sr-title { font-size: 20px; }
  .sr-sub { margin: 6px 0 0; }
  .sr-top .pill-btn.primary { display: none; }
  .mood-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(148px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
  .mood-card { font-size: 15px; padding: 14px; }
  .quick-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  #nav-mobile {
    display: flex; position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: var(--navm-h);
    background: var(--bg);
    border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--text) 8%, transparent);
    z-index: 45; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
    isolation: isolate;
  }
  #nav-mobile .nav-item {
    flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-size: 10px; padding: 8px 0;
    justify-content: center; align-items: center; border-radius: 0; font-weight: 600;
  }
  .carousel { grid-auto-columns: 156px; }
  .card { width: 156px; padding: 10px; }
  .card .art { width: 136px; height: 136px; }
  .detail-head { padding: 48px 16px 20px; margin: -18px -16px 8px; }
  .detail-head img { width: 150px; height: 150px; }
  #toast { bottom: calc(var(--navm-h) + 92px); }
  .lyric-line { font-size: 22px; }

  /* Track rows: ⋮ only - titles get the width */
  .track { gap: 10px; padding: 8px 6px; }
  .track .tbtn { display: none; }
  .track .btn-more { display: inline-flex !important; opacity: 1; }
  .track .btn-qrm, .track .btn-qup, .track .btn-qdn { display: none !important; }
  .track.q-user, .track.q-radio, .track.pl-track { cursor: pointer; }
  #queue-list .track.q-user .btn-more, #queue-list .track.q-radio .btn-more { touch-action: none; cursor: grab; }
  .track .tdur { min-width: 34px; font-size: 12px; }
  .track .tt { font-size: 14px; }
  .track.playing .eq { display: none; }
  #queue-list, #related-list { padding: 0; }
  .q-head { padding: 14px 6px 6px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .q-note { display: none; }
  .q-hint { padding: 4px 6px 10px; font-size: 12.5px; }

  /* Now Playing: fill the screen, not a floating island */
  .np-inner { padding: 2px 18px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
  .np-handle { margin: 4px auto 2px; }
  .np-tabs {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    overflow-x: auto;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    margin: 6px 0 2px;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .np-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .np-tab { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .np-pane { padding: 4px 0; }
  #np-player.active {
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 4px 0 6px;
  }
  .np-art-wrap {
    width: min(84vw, 46vh);
    max-width: 420px;
    flex-shrink: 1;
  }
  #np-title {
    font-size: 22px;
    line-height: 1.22;
    padding: 0 4px;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    word-break: break-word;
  }
  #np-artist {
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .np-controls { gap: 16px; }
  .play-big { width: 68px; height: 68px; }
  #np-float { display: none !important; }
  .np-actions {
    flex-wrap: nowrap;
    gap: 10px;
    width: 100%;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .np-actions .pill-btn {
    padding: 10px;
    border-color: transparent;
    background: hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.08);
  }
  .np-actions .pill-btn span { display: none; }
  .np-actions .pill-btn .ic { width: 20px; height: 20px; }
  #np-speed span, #np-quality span { display: inline; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; }
  #np-lyric-preview { min-height: 16px; font-size: 12.5px; }
}


/* Light theme: Now Playing stays dark (album art). Force light-on-dark controls. */
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying {
  background: #121212;
  color: #fff;
}
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .play-big {
  background: #fff !important;
  color: #111 !important;
}
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .icon-btn { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .icon-btn:hover { color: #fff; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .np-topbar .icon-btn {
  color: #fff;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .pill-btn {
  color: #fff;
  border-color: hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.42);
  background: hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.14);
}
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .pill-btn:hover { border-color: #fff; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying #np-title { color: #fff; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying #np-artist { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78); }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .np-seek { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .np-caption { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75); }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .track .tt { color: #fff; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .track.playing .tt { color: #1ed760; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .card .t { color: #fff; }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .card .s { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); }
html[data-theme="light"] #lyrics-source { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); }
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .np-tab {
  background: hsla(0, 0%, 100%, 0.16);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
}
html[data-theme="light"] #nowplaying .np-tab.active { background: #fff; color: #111; }

html[data-theme="light"] .modal-card {
  background: #fff;
  color: #121212;
  box-shadow: 0 16px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}
html[data-theme="light"] .modal-card h3,
html[data-theme="light"] .modal-row { color: #121212; }
html[data-theme="light"] .pl-form-label,
html[data-theme="light"] .pl-form-hint { color: #5a5a5a; }
html[data-theme="light"] .modal-card .pl-form-input {
  background: #f4f4f4;
  color: #121212;
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

/* ---------- Dnialify additions: settings/help/social/footer ---------- */
.sidebar-footer a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.sidebar-footer a:hover{color:var(--text)}
.sidebar-social{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:8px 8px 2px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sidebar-social a{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--hover-strong);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted);transition:background .15s,color .15s,transform .12s}
.sidebar-social a:hover{background:var(--accent-bright);color:#000;transform:scale(1.08)}
.sidebar-social .ic{width:14px;height:14px}
#settings-modal,#help-modal,#version-update-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:90;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
#settings-modal.hidden,#help-modal.hidden,#version-update-modal.hidden{display:none}
.settings-card{width:min(92vw,560px);max-height:85vh;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:12px;padding-bottom:0}
.settings-sticky{position:relative;flex-shrink:0;z-index:10;background:inherit;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)}
.settings-body{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:0 0 24px 0}
#settings-close{margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0}
.settings-head {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 16px 16px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.settings-head-row1 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
}
.settings-title {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin: 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  min-width: 0;
}
.settings-head-row2 {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.settings-mini-logo {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: 6px;
}
.settings-sub-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  min-width: 0;
}
.settings-sub-line1,
.settings-sub-line2 {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted);
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.settings-sub-line1 { opacity: 0.9; }
.settings-sub-line2 { opacity: 0.65; }
.about-value {
  font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.85;
}
.settings-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: nowrap;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 16px 12px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  min-height: 48px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.settings-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.settings-tabs .chip {
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  cursor: pointer;
  padding: 8px 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  height: 32px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.settings-tabs .chip.active {
  background: #fff;
  color: #000;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 8px 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.log-filter-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:6px 0;font-size:12px}
.log-filter-row input[type="datetime-local"],.log-filter-row select,.log-filter-row input[type="text"]{background:transparent;color:inherit;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 6px;font-size:12px;font-family:inherit}
.log-count{opacity:0.7;margin-left:auto;font-size:11px}
.log-view{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:11px;line-height:1.45;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;max-height:55vh;overflow-y:auto;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.35);border-radius:6px;padding:8px;margin:0}
.s-pane{display:none}
.s-pane.active{display:block}
.settings-p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:14px}
.settings-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px}
.settings-links .pill-btn{font-size:13px;padding:8px 14px}
.settings-credit{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:12px}
.settings-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 0 10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 6%,transparent)}
.s-label{font-size:13px;font-weight:400;text-transform:none;opacity:0.85}
.settings-row .pill-btn{font-size:13px;padding:7px 12px}
.settings-row>div:first-child{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.settings-row small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.settings-section-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text);opacity:1;padding:22px 0 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.settings-section--disabled{opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none}
.settings-section--locked{opacity:0.5;pointer-events:none}
.badge-soon{font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,200,0,0.2);color:#ffc800;margin-left:8px;text-transform:uppercase}
.settings-row--locked{opacity:0.6}
.settings-row--locked .pill-btn{pointer-events:none}
.vol-row{flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:6px 0}
.vol-label-capsul{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}
.vol-slider-wrap{flex:0 0 200px;min-width:200px;max-width:200px;width:200px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;align-items:stretch}
.vol-slider{position:relative;width:100%;height:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;touch-action:none;user-select:none;cursor:grab;outline:none;border-radius:6px;padding:0 6px}
.vol-slider:active{cursor:grabbing}
.vol-slider:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent-bright);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
.vol-track{position:absolute;left:6px;right:6px;top:50%;height:4px;background:var(--bar-bg);border-radius:2px;transform:translateY(-50%);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 6%,transparent)}
.vol-fill{position:absolute;left:6px;right:6px;top:50%;height:4px;background:transparent;border-radius:2px;transform:translateY(-50%);pointer-events:none;display:none}
.vol-dots{position:absolute;left:6px;right:6px;top:50%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;transform:translateY(-50%);pointer-events:none;padding:0}
.vol-dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--muted);box-shadow:none;transition:none;pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;padding:0;flex-shrink:0;transform:none}
.vol-dot.active{background:var(--accent-bright);border-color:var(--accent-bright);box-shadow:none;transform:none}
.vol-dot:hover{border-color:var(--text);background:var(--card-hover);transform:none}
.vol-dot.active:hover{transform:none}
.vol-thumb{position:absolute;top:50%;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent-bright);border:none;box-shadow:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:none;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;left:calc(12px + var(--pct,0.5) * (100% - 24px))}
.vol-labels{display:none}
.vol-value{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text);min-width:44px;text-align:center;background:var(--hover-strong);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--text) 6%,transparent)}
@media(max-width:600px){.vol-row{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}.vol-slider-wrap{max-width:none;width:100%}.vol-value{align-self:center}}
.help-card{width:min(92vw,480px)}
.help-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.help-grid div{background:var(--elevated);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px}
.help-grid b{color:var(--accent-bright)}
.help-tips{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6}
.help-tips p{margin-bottom:6px}
#settings-modal .modal-card,#help-modal .modal-card,#version-update-modal .modal-card{animation:popIn .22s ease}
@media(max-width:600px){.help-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* stats export / clear btns */
.lib-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.stat-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
/* error polish */
.empty-block{padding:48px 16px;text-align:center;min-height:40vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.empty-ic{width:64px;height:64px;margin:0 auto 16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--elevated);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--muted)}
.empty-ic .ic{width:28px;height:28px}
.empty-title{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px}
.empty-s{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.5}

/* Phase 11 refinement: MINI LYRIC PLAYER PiP - 10 lines, no card/box, dark bg, title tiny */
body.pip-system #float-widget {
  background: #000 !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
  padding: 8px 6px !important;
}
body.pip-system #float-widget { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
body.pip-system #fw-art { display: block !important; position: absolute !important; inset: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; object-fit: cover !important; opacity: 0.35 !important; z-index: -1; border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; filter: blur(25px) !important; transform: scale(1.12) !important; }

body.pip-system .fw-meta { background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,0,0,0.8), transparent) !important; padding-top: 8px !important; }

body.pip-system #fw-title { font-size: 11px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #fff !important; opacity: .95; }
body.pip-system #fw-artist { font-size: 10px !important; color: #9E9E9E !important; }
body.pip-system #fw-lyric {
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 0 !important;
}
/* PiP lyric window (created via JS) - 10 lines, active centered green */
body.pip-system #fw-lyrics-window { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 100%; align-items: center; margin-top: 6px; }
body.pip-system .fw-lyric-line { font-size: 12px; color: #8A8A8A !important; opacity: 1 !important; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 100%; line-height: 1.35; background: transparent !important; border: none !important; padding: 1px 0 !important; }
body.pip-system .fw-lyric-line.active { color: #1ED760 !important; font-size: 16px !important; font-weight: 700 !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
body.pip-system .fw-bar, body.pip-system .fw-controls { opacity: .6; }


/* Phase 8 offline rows (rev2: full-width rows, expand, limit, select, pin) */
.off-wrap{margin:6px 0}
.off-wrap.is-partial{opacity:.6}
.off-pin{margin-left:6px;color:#1db954;display:inline-flex}
.off-pin .ic{width:14px;height:14px}
.off-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:4px 0 10px}
.off-count{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.off-toolbar .pill-btn{margin-left:auto}
.off-wide{width:100%;justify-content:center;margin:8px 0}
.off-check{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;accent-color:#1db954}
.off-more{flex:none}
.track[data-offrow] .off-more{opacity:1}
@media (max-width: 860px){ .track[data-offrow] .off-more{display:inline-flex} }
.hidden { display: none !important; }
.track-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex: none; }
.track-check input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: #1db954; }
.track-art-wrap {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.dl-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 2px;
  right: 2px;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #1db954;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}
.dl-badge svg {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  fill: currentColor;
  display: block;
}
.dl-badge.dl-pending {
  color: #b3b3b3;
}
.track .tdur.is-empty { opacity: .45; }

.track-art-wrap.is-partial img,
.track-art-wrap.is-partial .art-ph-track {
  filter: grayscale(1);
}
.off-art-pct {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
  border-radius: 4px;
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #fff;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}
#offline-select-toolbar {
  position: fixed; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 16px;
  display: none; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  background: #1c1c1c; border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 12px 16px; z-index: 40;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
#offline-select-toolbar:not(.hidden) { display: flex; }
#offline-select-count { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.85; margin-right: auto; }
body.has-select-toolbar #main { padding-bottom: 80px; }
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  #offline-select-toolbar { bottom: calc(var(--navm-h, 64px) + 8px); }
  body.has-player #offline-select-toolbar { bottom: calc(var(--navm-h, 64px) + 80px); }
  body.has-select-toolbar #main { padding-bottom: calc(var(--navm-h, 64px) + 80px); }
  body.has-player.has-select-toolbar #main { padding-bottom: calc(var(--navm-h, 64px) + 152px); }
}
.track.selected { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); }
.track[data-offrow] { -webkit-touch-callout: none; -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; }
.track[data-offrow].selected .t-num { display: none; }
.detail-art { flex: none; }
.detail-art img { width: 224px; height: 224px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; }
.track-meta {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.track-title {
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.track-artist {
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-size: 12px;
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.track-actions {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

/* L40: desktop-only panel kanan — base hidden, aktif >=1024px */
#np-show-lyrics-btn { display: none; }
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
    /* 1. Sembunyikan tab Lyrics di panel kanan desktop */
    #nowplaying .np-tabs [data-nptab="lyrics"] {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* 2. Sembunyikan kontrol player di tab Song panel kanan */
    #nowplaying .np-player .np-seek,
    #nowplaying .np-player .np-controls {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* 3. Styling tombol Show Lyrics di panel kanan */
    #np-show-lyrics-btn {
        display: flex;
        width: 100%;
        background: var(--accent);
        color: #000;
        padding: 12px;
        border-radius: 8px;
        font-weight: 700;
        justify-content: center;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        margin-top: 16px;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
    }
    /* L47: ikon SVG di tombol Show Lyrics (pengganti emoji mic) */
    #np-show-lyrics-btn .ic {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
        fill: currentColor;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    /* 4. Overlay Lirik di Area Tengah — L51: full width (sidebar + main), circle art, Spotify green */
    #main-lyrics-overlay {
        position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 50;
        background: var(--bg); padding: 32px;
        display: none; flex-direction: column;
    }
    #main-lyrics-overlay.active {
        display: flex;
        position: fixed;
        top: 8px;
        left: 8px;
        right: calc(340px + 16px);
        bottom: calc(var(--player-h) + 8px);
        z-index: 50;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1db954 0%, #121212 100%);
        border-radius: 8px;
        /* L54: margin kiri & kanan sama (tidak terlalu lebar, tidak tipis) */
        padding: 32px clamp(28px, 6vw, 88px);

        box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    }
    /* L52: panel kanan ditutup -> overlay lirik melebar penuh menutupi panel kanan */

        margin-bottom: 32px;

        align-items: center;
        gap: 16px;
        min-width: 0;
    }
    .lo-circle-art {
        width: 64px;
        height: 64px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        object-fit: cover;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);

    .lo-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
    .lo-title {
        font-size: 24px;
        font-weight: 800;
        color: #fff;
        line-height: 1.2;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        max-width: 100%;
    }
    .lo-artist {
        font-size: 16px;
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
        line-height: 1.3;
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .lo-close-btn {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        border: none;
        color: #fff;
        width: 40px;
        height: 40px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        cursor: pointer;
        font-size: 20px;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .lo-close-btn:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); }
    /* L41: cegah scrollbar #view menembus di balik overlay */
    /* L42: bekukan panel di belakang overlay (#view + #main) */

        overflow: hidden !important;

        overflow-x: hidden;

        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.5;
        text-align: left;
        padding-right: 10px;
    }
    #main-lyrics-body .lyric-line.active {
        color: #fff;
        text-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    }
    #main { position: relative; }

    /* L43+L44: layout baris antrean di right panel desktop */
    /* L44.2 Posisi Baris Antrean (L43 + position:relative) */
    #nowplaying .track,

        position: relative;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 12px;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 8px;
        border-radius: 6px;
        cursor: pointer;

    /* L44.3 Container Teks (Judul & Artis) - tidak berubah dari L43 */

        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: center;
    }

    #nowplaying .track .tt {
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: var(--text);
        white-space: nowrap;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;
        display: block;

        overflow: hidden;
        text-overflow: ellipsis;

    #nowplaying .right-content,
    #nowplaying .np-queue,

        flex: 1;
        min-height: 0; /* Sangat penting agar flexbox bisa scroll */
        overflow-y: auto !important;
    }

       semua tombol di satu titik -> reveal tetap in-flow (keputusan
       L44); jarak antar ikon 12px tetap lewat gap .track (:1956).

       extras bakal numpuk di titik yang sama). */

    #nowplaying .track .q-actions { /* .q-actions: inert, tidak ada di repo */
        display: none;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;

        padding: 0; /* HAPUS PADDING */
        border-radius: 0; /* HAPUS SUDUT MELENGKUNG */
        color: var(--muted);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    #nowplaying .track:hover .tbtn,
    #nowplaying .track:hover .q-actions { display: flex; }
    #nowplaying .track .tbtn:hover { color: var(--text); }
    /* L55: durasi di queue HARUS selalu terlihat.
       Rule L44.6 (opacity:0 saat hover) dihapus — itulah yang membuat semua
       durasi "hilang" begitu kursor berada di atas daftar antrean. Durasi
       sekarang tidak boleh menyusut, didorong ke kanan, dan tombol aksi hover
       dibuat ringkas (width 18px + gap baris 6px) supaya durasi tidak
       terpotong keluar panel 340px. */
    #nowplaying .track .tdur,
    #nowplaying .track .duration { /* .duration: inert, tidak ada di repo */
        flex-shrink: 0;
        margin-left: auto;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }
    #nowplaying .track:hover { gap: 6px; }
    /* L56: PAKSA durasi tampil. Mapping: --text-secondary tidak ada di repo
       -> var(--muted) (pola warna sekunder repo, cth :476/:884).
       span[class*="dur"] ikut menangkap .tdur.is-empty dan alias lain. */
    #nowplaying .track .tdur,
    #nowplaying .track .t-dur,
    #nowplaying .track span[class*="dur"] {
        display: inline-block !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        opacity: 1 !important;
        width: auto !important;
        min-width: 35px !important;
        flex-shrink: 0 !important;
        color: var(--muted) !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        text-align: right;
        margin-left: 8px;
    }
    /* Pastikan teks judul/artis tidak menabrak durasi */
    #nowplaying .track .tmeta { overflow: hidden; }
    #nowplaying .track .t-num { display: none; }
}


/* L51: 1024-1099px right panel masih fullscreen (bukan sidebar 340px), overlay tetap di dalam #main */
@media (min-width: 1024px) and (max-width: 1099px) {
    #main-lyrics-overlay.active {
        top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        /* L54: margin kiri-kanan tetap sama di layar sempit */
        padding: 24px clamp(24px, 5vw, 56px);
    }
}

/* L52/L58: tombol Playlist lama di tab Song disembunyikan HANYA di desktop —
   Add sudah pindah ke baris .rp-actions-row agar tidak dobel ikon "+".
   Di mobile baris .rp-actions-row tidak dipakai, jadi Add harus tetap tampil
   (Like / Add / More = 3 tombol). */
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
    #nowplaying #np-addpl { display: none; }
}

/* ===== L57: mini bar widget/add split + urutan Now Playing mobile ===== */
/* TUGAS 4: Widget (PiP) hanya Mobile/Tablet, Add to Queue hanya Desktop */
@media (max-width: 1023px) {
    #mini-add-queue { display: none !important; }
}
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
    #mini-float { display: none !important; }
}

/* TUGAS 3: revert tampilan Now Playing MOBILE (desktop tidak tersentuh)
   ATAS  : judul + artis + client (iFrame/VisionOS/Offline)
   TENGAH: progress bar + media controls
   BAWAH : Like / Add / More */
@media (max-width: 1023px) {
    #np-player.active { flex-direction: column; }
    #np-player .np-meta { order: 1; }
    #np-player .np-seek { order: 2; }
    #np-player .np-controls { order: 3; }
    #np-player .np-actions { order: 4; }
    /* baris aksi ringkas milik right panel desktop tidak dipakai di mobile */
    #np-player .rp-actions-row { display: none !important; }
    /* client badge tampil lagi di mobile (L48 hanya menyembunyikan di panel kanan) */
    #nowplaying #np-method { display: block !important; }
}

/* ===== L58: modal input nama user + sapaan dinamis ===== */
.modal-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 90;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}
.modal-overlay.hidden { display: none !important; }
.modal-box {
    background: var(--elevated);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    width: min(92vw, 400px);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
    animation: modalEnter 0.42s var(--ease-spring);
}
.modal-box h2 {
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin: 0 0 6px;
}
.modal-box p {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.modal-box input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--hover-strong);
    border: 0;
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 500;
    outline: none;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.modal-box input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--accent); }
.modal-box .btn-primary {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    background: var(--accent-bright);
    color: #000;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 800;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.modal-box .btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); }
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .modal-box { padding: 22px 18px; border-radius: 14px; }
    .modal-box h2 { font-size: 18px; }
    /* 16px mencegah auto-zoom keyboard iOS saat input difokuskan */
    .modal-box input { font-size: 16px; }
}

const CACHE='dnialify-assets-v3.5.1';
const ASSETS=['/','/index.html','/styles.css','/app.js','/logo.png','/logo-192.png','/manifest.json'];
self.addEventListener('message',e=>{
  if(e.data && e.data.type==='SKIP_WAITING') self.skipWaiting();
});
self.addEventListener('install',e=>{e.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(c=>c.addAll(ASSETS)).then(()=>self.skipWaiting()))});
self.addEventListener('activate',e=>{e.waitUntil(caches.keys().then(ks=>Promise.all(ks.filter(k=>k!==CACHE && k.startsWith('dnialify-')).map(k=>caches.delete(k)))).then(()=>self.clients.claim()))});
self.addEventListener('fetch',e=>{
  const u=new URL(e.request.url);
  if(u.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;
  // All versioned assets → network-first biar tidak stale 2.1.5 saat sudah 2.1.6 (HTML + JS/CSS)
  const isVersioned = e.request.mode==='navigate' || u.pathname==='/' || u.pathname.endsWith('.html') || u.pathname.endsWith('/app.js') || u.pathname.endsWith('/styles.css') || u.pathname.endsWith('/sw.js');
  if(isVersioned){
    e.respondWith(fetch(e.request,{cache:'no-store'}).then(res=>{
      if(res.ok && u.origin===location.origin){
        const c=res.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(cache=>cache.put(e.request,c));
      }
      return res;
    }).catch(()=> caches.match(e.request)));
    return;
  }
  e.respondWith(caches.match(e.request).then(r=> r || fetch(e.request).then(res=>{
    if(res.ok && e.request.method==='GET' && u.origin===location.origin){
      const c=res.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(cache=>cache.put(e.request,c));
    }
    return res;
  }).catch(()=> r)));
});

```markdown
# Dnialify Music Stream - Dnialify Project

**Pemutar musik web gratis** bergaya Spotify, katalog [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com). Tanpa akun.
By **Dnialify Project** - danial.alfat7

- **Creator:** Dnialify Project
- **WA:** 089648528585
- **Facebook:** [facebook.com/danial.alfat7](https://www.facebook.com/danial.alfat7/)
- **Instagram:** [@dann4lfat_](https://instagram.com/dann4lfat_)
- **Twitter/X:** [@dann4lfat_](https://twitter.com/dann4lfat_)
- **Telegram:** [@dann4lfat](https://t.me/dann4lfat)

Project ini **gratis** dan **bebas dipakai**.

---

## Tentang

Dnialify Music Stream adalah pemutar musik di browser. Cari lagu, buka album dan artis, buat playlist, lihat lirik, atur antrian - semuanya tanpa daftar akun.

Library (favorit, playlist, riwayat, statistik) tersimpan di perangkatmu. Audio diputar lewat pemutar resmi YouTube.

Tidak berafiliasi dengan YouTube, Google, atau Spotify.

---

## Kontak Dnialify Project

Hubungi untuk request fitur, bug, atau collab:

- **WA:** 089648528585
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/danial.alfat7/
- **Instagram:** https://instagram.com/dann4lfat_
- **Twitter:** https://twitter.com/dann4lfat_
- **Telegram:** https://t.me/dann4lfat

---

## Cara memakai website

1. Buka website Dnialify Music Stream kamu
2. Cari lagu, atau pilih dari Home / Charts / Browse all
3. Lagu pertama langsung play. Kalau klik lagu lain, Now Playing menampilkan lagu baru - tekan **Play** untuk mengganti putaran
4. Ikon hati = favorit. **Playlist** = simpan ke folder. Di halaman album/artis, **Save** masuk tab Saved
5. Pindah HP? Library → **Backup**, di perangkat baru **Restore**

### Desktop / PC

Di laptop atau komputer, Dnialify Music Stream langsung siap. Buka situsnya, pilih lagu, dan putar - tidak perlu pengaturan tambahan.

### Putar di latar belakang (Android)

Musik tetap jalan saat layar terkunci atau pindah aplikasi, **tanpa mode desktop**.

Buka site di **[Brave Browser](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brave.browser)** - putar lagu, lalu keluar dari tab atau kunci HP. Audio tetap berlanjut.

Di Chrome, aktifkan **⋮ → Situs desktop** jika ingin hasil serupa.

---

## Fitur

### Home
- Sapaan sesuai waktu dan tanggal
- Recently played
- Mix for you - rekomendasi dari favorit & riwayat
- Liked songs, playlist lokal, item Saved
- Rak YouTube Music
- Carousel geser; di desktop ada panah

### Search
- Saran otomatis saat mengetik
- Filter: All, Songs, Videos, Albums, Artists, Playlists
- Top result sebagai kartu besar
- Hasil dikelompokkan (lagu, album, artis, playlist)
- Riwayat pencarian
- Browse all - mood & genre

### Charts
- Tangga lagu, playlist genre, artis teratas

### Library
Tanpa login, tersimpan di perangkat ini.

| Tab | Isi |
| --- | --- |
| Playlists | Playlist buatanmu + kartu Liked Songs |
| Favorites | Lagu yang di-heart, Play all / Shuffle |
| Saved | Album, playlist, artis yang di-Save |
| History | Yang baru diputar |
| Stats | Total putar, menit, top artis, lagu terbanyak |

- New playlist
- Import dari link YouTube Music (playlist, album, artis, lagu)
- Backup / Restore file JSON
- Rename, hapus, urutkan lagu (panah atau drag di desktop)

### Player
- Streaming YouTube IFrame (audio YouTube Music)
- Quality di menu ⋮ - bisa dinaikkan ke YouTube max
- Preview lagu lain tanpa memutus yang sedang play
- Shuffle & Repeat (mati / semua / satu)
- Kecepatan 0.5×-2×
- Antrian: Your queue dulu, lalu radio. Tersimpan saat refresh
- Play next / Add to queue
- Related: lagu, album, playlist, artis
- Lirik sinkron - tap baris untuk loncat
- Share (menu HP atau salin tautan)
- Download MP3
- SponsorBlock - skip intro/sponsor (bisa dimatikan)
- Sleep timer
- Widget mengambang + Picture-in-Picture
- Mode gelap / terang
- Nama artis bisa diklik ke halaman artis

### Pintasan keyboard

| Tombol | Aksi |
| --- | --- |
| `Space` | Play / Pause |
| `Shift` + `→` | Berikutnya |
| `Shift` + `←` | Sebelumnya |
| `Esc` | Tutup Now Playing |
| `L` | Ganti tema |
| `P` | Widget |
| `?` | Buka bantuan shortcut |

---

## Menjalankan di komputer sendiri

Perlu [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) 18+ (disarankan 20).

```bash
git clone <repo-kamu>
cd music-stream
npm install
npm start
```

Buka **http://localhost:3000**

---

## Deploy ke Vercel

```bash
npm i -g vercel
vercel login
vercel --prod
```

Atau di dashboard Vercel: **Import Git Repository** → pilih repo kamu → Deploy.

music-stream/

const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const version = process.argv[2];
if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+(-beta\.\d+)?$/.test(version || '')) {
  console.error('Usage: npm run version:bump -- <major.minor.patch> or <major.minor.patch-beta.N>');
  process.exit(1);
}

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const packagePath = path.join(root, 'package.json');
const packageData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(packagePath, 'utf8'));
const previous = packageData.version;
packageData.version = version;
fs.writeFileSync(packagePath, `${JSON.stringify(packageData, null, 2)}\n`);

const lockPath = path.join(root, 'package-lock.json');
const lockData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(lockPath, 'utf8'));
lockData.version = version;
if (lockData.packages?.['']) lockData.packages[''].version = version;
fs.writeFileSync(lockPath, `${JSON.stringify(lockData, null, 2)}\n`);

// delegate injection to single source of truth script
require('./inject-version.js');
```

### Path: scripts/bump.js

> 964 byte | 24 baris | javascript | sha1:3b639af2e58d

```javascript
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

// npm run bump [version] - bump frontend version without changing APK version.
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
const current = pkg.webVersion || pkg.version;
const requested = process.argv[2];
const m = /^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(-beta\.(\d+))?$/.exec(current || '');
if (!m) {
  console.error(`Cannot bump: invalid webVersion "${current}" in package.json`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const next = requested || (m[4] != null
  ? `${m[1]}.${m[2]}.${m[3]}-beta.${Number(m[5]) + 1}`
  : `${m[1]}.${m[2]}.${Number(m[3]) + 1}`);
if (!/^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)(-beta\.\d+)?$/.test(next)) {
  console.error('Usage: npm run bump -- <major.minor.patch>');
  process.exit(1);
}
process.argv[2] = next;
require('./bump-web-version.js');
console.log(`${current} -> ${next} (APK remains ${pkg.version})`);
```

#!/usr/bin/env node
/* Byte-vs-duration hypothesis validation (no ADB).
   For each videoId: resolve audio itag 251 (opus) via WEB_REMIX, record
   metadata duration (lengthSeconds) + total bytes (contentLength, verified
   with a bytes=0-0 Range probe), estimate true duration from bytes using the
   format bitrate (fallback 128000), classify MATCH <5% / MISMATCH >5% /
   CRITICAL >20%.
   Usage: node scripts/byte-vs-duration-test.js [--out=DIR]
   Writes results.jsonl to out dir (default Temp/byte-vs-duration). */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36';
const REQ_TIMEOUT_MS = 25000;
const FALLBACK_BPS = 128000;

const VIDEOS = [
  'dQw4w9WgXcQ', '9bZkp7q19f0', 'e-ORhEE9VVg', 'RgKAFK5djSk', 'kJQP7kiw5Fk',
  'k15wcUamnJA', 'hTWKbfoikeg', '60ItHLz5WEA', 'JGwWNGJdvx8', 'YQHsXMglC9A',
];

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function fetchTimeout(url, opts = {}, ms = REQ_TIMEOUT_MS) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), ms);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: ctl.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(t);
  }
}

async function resolveAudio(videoId) {
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    context: { client: {
      clientName: 'ANDROID', clientVersion: '20.10.38', androidSdkVersion: 35, hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
    } },
    videoId, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true,
  });
  const res = await fetchTimeout('https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'com.google.android.youtube/20.10.38 (Linux; U; Android 14; en_US)',
      'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2' },
    body,
  });
  if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}` };
  const data = await res.json();
  const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
  const vd = data.videoDetails || {};
  const fmts = [...(data.streamingData?.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(data.streamingData?.formats || [])];
  const aud = fmts.filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/') && f.url);
  if (!aud.length) return { ok: false, error: `no audio w/ url (playability=${ps.status})` };
  aud.sort((a, b) => {
    const ao = /itag.?251|\b251\b/.test(String(a.itag)) || (a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0);
    const bo = /itag.?251|\b251\b/.test(String(b.itag)) || (b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0);
    const av = a.itag === 251 ? 2 : (a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0);
    const bv = b.itag === 251 ? 2 : (b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0);
    if (av !== bv) return bv - av;
    return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
  });
  const best = aud[0];
  return {
    ok: true,
    title: vd.title || null,
    metaSec: vd.lengthSeconds ? parseInt(vd.lengthSeconds, 10) : null,
    itag: best.itag, mime: best.mimeType, bitrate: best.bitrate || null,
    clen: best.contentLength ? parseInt(best.contentLength, 10) : null,
    url: best.url,
  };
}

async function probeTotal(url) {
  // bytes=0-0: cheap, proves URL alive + authoritative total via content-range.
  const r = await fetchTimeout(url, { headers: { Range: 'bytes=0-0', 'User-Agent': UA } });
  if (r.status !== 206 && r.status !== 200) return { ok: false, error: `probe HTTP ${r.status}` };
  await r.arrayBuffer().catch(() => null);
  const cr = r.headers.get('content-range');
  const m = cr && cr.match(/\/(\d+)\s*$/);
  const cl = r.headers.get('content-length');
  const total = m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : (cl ? parseInt(cl, 10) : null);
  if (!total) return { ok: false, error: 'probe: no total' };
  return { ok: true, total };

  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(def.context));
  let vdAttached = false;
  try {
    if (vdOpt === 'fresh') {
      ctx.client.visitorData = await fetchVd(name);
      vdAttached = true;
    } else if (vdOpt === 'slot') {
      if (!vdStore[name]) await fetchVd(name);
      if (def.useVd) { ctx.client.visitorData = vdStore[name]; vdAttached = true; }
    }
    const res = await fetchTimeout(def.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', headers: def.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx, videoId, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}`, vdAttached };
    const data = await res.json();
    const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
    const sd = data.streamingData;
    if (!sd) return { ok: false, error: `no streamingData playability=${ps.status}`, vdAttached };
    const formats = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])];
    const audios = formats.filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats', vdAttached };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}`, vdAttached, itag: best.itag };
    return {
      ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag, mime: best.mimeType,
      total: best.contentLength ? parseInt(best.contentLength, 10) : null,
      host: new URL(best.url).host, vdAttached,
      durSec: data.videoDetails?.lengthSeconds ? parseInt(data.videoDetails.lengthSeconds, 10) : null,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}`, vdAttached };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, {
      headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA },
    });
    const buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
    return { status: r.status, bytes: buf.byteLength, buf, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', bytes: 0, buf: null, ms: Date.now() - t0, err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

// 5-step ladder, 10s budget. Returns {step, buf, sub} or {step:0}.
async function ladder(video, byte, end, curUrl) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const budgetLeft = () => LADDER_BUDGET_MS - (Date.now() - t0);
  const tryUrl = async (u) => {
    const g = await getRange(u, byte, end);
    if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - byte + 1) return g.buf;
    return null;
  };
  // L1: same URL retry after 500ms
  if (budgetLeft() > 600) {
    await sleep(500);
    const b = await tryUrl(curUrl);
    if (b) return { step: 1, buf: b, sub: null, url: curUrl };
  }
  // L2: same client, same VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('VISIONOS', video, 'slot');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 2, buf: b, sub: null, host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L3: same client, fresh VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('VISIONOS', video, 'fresh');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 3, buf: b, sub: null, host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L4: fallback ANDROID
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('ANDROID', video, 'slot');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 4, buf: b, sub: 'ANDROID', host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L5: fallback ANDROID_VR + fresh VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('ANDROID_VR', video, 'fresh');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 5, buf: b, sub: 'ANDROID_VR', host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  return { step: 0, buf: null, sub: null };
}

async function simSong(video, outDir) {
  const t0wall = Date.now();
  const out = { mode: 'SIM', client: 'VISIONOS', video,
    itag: null, host: null, durMs: null, total: null, totalChunks: null,
    events403: [], recoveries: [], stalls: 0, totalStallMs: 0, gapMaxMs: 0,
    playMsEnd: 0, wallMs: null, cacheFillMs: null,
    playbackFinished: false, fileIntact: false, status: null, partFile: null };
  const r = await resolveClient('VISIONOS', video, 'slot');
  if (!r.ok || !r.total || !r.durSec) {
    out.status = 'SIM_FAIL_RESOLVE';
    out.resolveError = r.error || 'no total/duration';
    out.ms = Date.now() - t0wall;
    return out;
  }
  out.itag = r.itag; out.host = r.host; out.vdAttached = r.vdAttached;
  const total = r.total;
  const durMs = r.durSec * 1000;
  out.total = total; out.durMs = durMs;
  const nChunks = Math.ceil(total / CHUNK);
  out.totalChunks = nChunks;
  const chunkDurMs = (CHUNK / total) * durMs;
  const idxOf = (playMs) => Math.min(nChunks - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(playMs / chunkDurMs)));
  let url = r.url;
  const partFile = path.join(outDir, `${video}.part`);
  out.partFile = partFile;
  const fd = fs.openSync(partFile, 'w');
  const have = new Set();
  const writeChunk = (idx, buf) => {
    // chunks arrive in order except ladder recoveries; use positional write
    fs.writeSync(fd, buf, 0, buf.byteLength, idx * CHUNK);
    have.add(idx);
  };
  const fetchWrite = async (idx) => {
    const start = idx * CHUNK;
    const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK - 1, total - 1);
    const g = await getRange(url, start, end);
    return { ...g, idx, start, end };
  };

  // initial window 0..4 (blocking, before playback)
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(WINDOW, nChunks); i += 1) {
    const g = await fetchWrite(i);
    if (g.status === 206 && g.bytes === g.end - g.start + 1) {
      writeChunk(i, g.buf);
    } else {
      if (g.status === 403) out.events403.push({ chunk: i, byte: g.start, playMs: 0, phase: 'init' });
      const lr = await ladder(video, g.start, g.end, url);
      if (lr.step > 0) {
        if (lr.url) url = lr.url;
        out.recoveries.push({ chunk: i, step: lr.step, sub: lr.sub, host: lr.host || null });
        writeChunk(i, lr.buf);
      } else {
        fs.closeSync(fd);
        out.status = 'SIM_FAIL_INIT';
        out.ms = Date.now() - t0wall;
        return out;
      }
    }
  }

  const t0 = Date.now();
  let playMs = 0;
  let stallMs = 0;
  let stallRun = 0;
  let cacheFillMs = null;
  let broken = null;
  const stopAt = durMs - 5000;
  for (;;) {
    const tickStart = Date.now();
    const expected = (tickStart - t0) - stallMs;
    const need = idxOf(expected);
    if (have.has(need)) {
      playMs = expected;
      stallRun = 0;
    } else {
      stallMs += TICK;
      stallRun += TICK;
      out.stalls += 1;
      out.totalStallMs += TICK;
      if (stallRun > out.gapMaxMs) out.gapMaxMs = stallRun;
    }
    // window fill ahead of current need
    const cur = idxOf(playMs);
    for (let idx = cur + 1; idx <= Math.min(cur + WINDOW, nChunks - 1); idx += 1) {
      if (have.has(idx)) continue;
      const g = await fetchWrite(idx);
      if (g.status === 206 && g.bytes === g.end - g.start + 1) {
        writeChunk(idx, g.buf);
      } else {
        if (g.status === 403) {
          out.events403.push({ chunk: idx, byte: g.start, playMs: Math.round(playMs), phase: 'window' });
        }
        const lr = await ladder(video, g.start, g.end, url);
        if (lr.step > 0) {
          if (lr.url) url = lr.url;
          if (lr.host) out.host = `${out.host}+${lr.host}`;
          out.recoveries.push({ chunk: idx, step: lr.step, sub: lr.sub, host: lr.host || null });
          writeChunk(idx, lr.buf);
        } else {
          broken = { atPlayMs: Math.round(playMs), chunk: idx, byte: g.start };
          break;
        }
      }
      if (have.size === nChunks && cacheFillMs === null) cacheFillMs = Date.now() - t0;
    }
    if (broken) break;
    if (playMs >= stopAt) break;
    if (Date.now() - t0 > durMs + 180000) { broken = { guard: 'timeout', atPlayMs: Math.round(playMs) }; break; }
    const spent = Date.now() - tickStart;
    if (spent < TICK) await sleep(TICK - spent);
  }
  fs.closeSync(fd);
  out.playMsEnd = Math.round(playMs);
  out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
  out.cacheFillMs = cacheFillMs;
  out.playbackFinished = !broken && playMs >= stopAt;
  try {
    out.fileIntact = fs.statSync(partFile).size === total && have.size === nChunks;
  } catch { out.fileIntact = false; }
  if (broken) {
    out.status = 'SIM_BROKEN';
    out.broken = broken;
  } else if (!out.playbackFinished) {
    out.status = 'SIM_INCOMPLETE';
  } else if (!out.fileIntact) {
    out.status = 'SIM_FILE_SHORT';
  } else if (out.gapMaxMs > STALL_OK_MAX) {
    out.status = 'SIM_STALL_FAIL';
  } else {
    out.status = 'SIM_OK';
  }
  out.ms = Date.now() - t0wall;
  return out;
}

(async () => {
  const o = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  fs.mkdirSync(o.out, { recursive: true });
  const jsonl = path.join(o.out, 'results.jsonl');
  const log = (obj) => fs.appendFileSync(jsonl, JSON.stringify(obj) + '\n');
  console.log(`SONGS: ${o.songs.join(',')} OUT: ${o.out} TS: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  for (const video of o.songs) {
    const songDir = path.join(o.out, video);
    fs.mkdirSync(songDir, { recursive: true });

    console.log(`[${video}] dur=${r.durMs === null ? '?' : Math.round(r.durMs / 1000) + 's'} ` +
      `chunks=${r.totalChunks === null ? '?' : r.totalChunks} 403s=${r.events403.length} ` +
      `first403=${r.events403.length ? `chunk${r.events403[0].chunk}@${r.events403[0].byte}/play${Math.round(r.events403[0].playMs / 1000)}s` : '-'} ` +
      `rec=[${r.recoveries.map((x) => `c${x.chunk}:L${x.step}${x.sub ? '/' + x.sub : ''}`).join(',')}] ` +
      `gapMax=${r.gapMaxMs}ms stalls=${r.stalls} playEnd=${Math.round((r.playMsEnd || 0) / 1000)}s ` +
      `fillMs=${r.cacheFillMs} wallMs=${r.wallMs} finished=${r.playbackFinished} intact=${r.fileIntact} status=${r.status}`);
    await sleep(30000); // breather between songs
  }
  console.log(`DONE. raw: ${jsonl}`);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1); });

const REQ_TIMEOUT_MS = 25000;

const DEF = {
  endpoint: 'https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
  gapis: 'https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/',
  context: { client: {
    clientName: 'VISIONOS', clientVersion: '1.02', deviceModel: 'RealityDevice14,1',
    osName: 'visionOS', osVersion: '25.6.0.23O471', hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
  } },
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'User-Agent': 'com.google.visionos.youtube/1.02(RealityDevice14,1; U; CPU visionOS 25_6_0 like Mac OS X; US)',
    'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
  },
};

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const o = { out: DEFAULT_OUT, vds: 10, capMin: 15, probeSec: 60, budgetMin: 8.5,
    summary: false, song: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' };
  for (const a of argv) {
    if (a.startsWith('--out=')) o.out = a.slice(6);
    else if (a.startsWith('--vds=')) o.vds = Math.max(1, parseInt(a.slice(6), 10) || 10);
    else if (a.startsWith('--cap-min=')) o.capMin = Math.max(1, parseFloat(a.slice(10)) || 15);
    else if (a.startsWith('--probe-sec=')) o.probeSec = Math.max(10, parseInt(a.slice(12), 10) || 60);
    else if (a.startsWith('--budget-min=')) o.budgetMin = Math.max(1, parseFloat(a.slice(13)) || 8.5);
    else if (a === '--summary') o.summary = true;
    else if (a.startsWith('--song=')) o.song = a.slice(7).trim() || o.song;
  }
  return o;
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function fetchTimeout(url, opts = {}, ms = REQ_TIMEOUT_MS) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), ms);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: ctl.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(t);
  }
}

async function fetchVdOnce() {
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEF.context));
  const res = await fetchTimeout(`${DEF.gapis}visitor_id?prettyPrint=false`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: DEF.headers, body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`visitor_id HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const vd = (await res.json())?.responseContext?.visitorData;
  if (!vd) throw new Error('visitor_id: no visitorData');
  return vd;
}

async function resolveWithVd(video, vd) {
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEF.context));
  if (vd) ctx.client.visitorData = vd;
  try {
    const res = await fetchTimeout(DEF.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', headers: DEF.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx, videoId: video, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}` };
    const data = await res.json();
    const sd = data.streamingData;
    if (!sd) {
      const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
      return { ok: false, error: `no streamingData playability=${ps.status} reason=${ps.reason || '-'}` };
    }
    const audios = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])]
      .filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats' };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}` };
    return { ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag, host: new URL(best.url).host };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}` };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end) {
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, {
      headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA },
    });
    await r.arrayBuffer();
    return { status: r.status };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

function loadState(out) {
  const p = path.join(out, 'vd-state.json');
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return { vds: [], lastFetchTs: 0, song: null };
  }
}
function saveState(out, st) {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'vd-state.json'), JSON.stringify(st, null, 1));
}

(async () => {
  const o = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  fs.mkdirSync(o.out, { recursive: true });
  const jsonl = path.join(o.out, 'results.jsonl');
  const log = (obj) => fs.appendFileSync(jsonl, JSON.stringify(obj) + '\n');
  const st = loadState(o.out);
  if (!st.song) st.song = o.song;

  if (o.summary) {
    console.log('VD | fetchTs | failTs | ageMin | result | note');
    for (const v of st.vds) {
      const age = v.failTs ? ((v.failTs - v.fetchTs) / 60000).toFixed(1)
        : (((Date.now() - v.fetchTs) / 60000).toFixed(1) + '+');
      console.log(`#${v.n} | ${new Date(v.fetchTs).toISOString().slice(11, 19)} | ` +
        `${v.failTs ? new Date(v.failTs).toISOString().slice(11, 19) : '-'} | ${age} | ` +
        `${v.fetchFail ? 'FETCH_FAIL' : v.failKind ? 'FAIL(' + v.failKind + ')' : v.censored ? 'CENSORED' : 'ACTIVE'} | ${v.note || ''}`);
    }
    return;
  }

  console.log(`VD-LIFETIME song=${st.song} target=${o.vds} cap=${o.capMin}min probe=${o.probeSec}s budget=${o.budgetMin}min OUT: ${o.out}`);
  const runStart = Date.now();
  const deadline = runStart + o.budgetMin * 60000;
  const grid0 = runStart;
  let tick = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now >= deadline) break;
    // (a) fetch next VD if due (staggered 1/min)
    const pending = st.vds.length;
    if (pending < o.vds && (pending === 0 || now - st.lastFetchTs >= 60000)) {
      const n = pending + 1;
      try {
        const vd = await fetchVdOnce();
        st.vds.push({ n, vd, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: false });
        st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
        console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] ok`);
        log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, fetchTs: st.lastFetchTs });
      } catch (e) {
        await sleep(5000);
        try {
          const vd = await fetchVdOnce();
          st.vds.push({ n, vd, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: false });
          st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
          console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] ok (retry)`);
          log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, fetchTs: st.lastFetchTs, retried: true });
        } catch (e2) {
          st.vds.push({ n, vd: null, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: true, fetchFail: true, note: String((e2 && e2.message) || e2) });
          st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
          console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] FAIL ${e2.message}`);
          log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, ok: false, error: String((e2 && e2.message) || e2) });
        }
      }
      saveState(o.out, st);
    }
    // (b) probe all active VDs
    for (const v of st.vds) {
      if (v.done || !v.vd) continue;
      const ageMin = (Date.now() - v.fetchTs) / 60000;
      if (ageMin >= o.capMin) {
        v.done = true; v.censored = true;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] CENSORED age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min`);
        log({ mode: 'VD_CENSORED', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1) });
        continue;
      }
      const r = await resolveWithVd(st.song, v.vd);
      if (!r.ok) {
        v.done = true; v.failTs = Date.now(); v.failKind = 'resolve';
        v.note = r.error;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] FAIL-resolve age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min ${r.error}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: false, kind: 'resolve', detail: r.error });
        continue;
      }
      let bad = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        const g = await getRange(r.url, i * CHUNK, Math.min(i * CHUNK + CHUNK - 1, 3 * CHUNK - 1));
        if (g.status !== 206) { bad = { chunk: i, status: g.status }; break; }
      }
      if (bad) {
        v.done = true; v.failTs = Date.now(); v.failKind = 'dl';
        v.note = `chunk${bad.chunk}=${bad.status}`;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] FAIL-dl age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min ${v.note}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: false, kind: 'dl', detail: v.note });
      } else {
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] ok age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min host=${r.host}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: true, host: r.host });
      }
    }
    saveState(o.out, st);
    const allDone = st.vds.length >= o.vds && st.vds.every((v) => v.done);
    if (allDone) { console.log('ALL DONE'); break; }
    tick += 1;
    const nextGrid = grid0 + tick * o.probeSec * 1000;
    const wait = nextGrid - Date.now();
    if (wait > 0) await sleep(wait);
  }
  saveState(o.out, st);
  console.log(`RUN END. state: ${path.join(o.out, 'vd-state.json')} raw: ${jsonl}`);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1); });

/**
 * dump-indexes.js - indeks otomatis dari berkas yang disertakan.
 * Semua angka dihitung dari isi berkas nyata (bukan hardcode).

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const CTRL = new Set([
  'if', 'for', 'while', 'switch', 'catch', 'return', 'do', 'else', 'try',
  'synchronized', 'new', 'throw', 'case', 'super', 'this',
]);

function lineNumbersOf(content) {
  return content.split('\n');
}

function jsSymbols(content) {
  const lines = lineNumbersOf(content);
  const out = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const t = lines[i];
    let m;
    if ((m = /^(?:async\s+)?function\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\(/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'fn', name: m[1] });
    } else if ((m = /^(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?function\b/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'fn', name: m[1] });
    } else if ((m = /^(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*(?:async\s*)?\(/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'fn', name: m[1] });
    } else if ((m = /^(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*=\s*\{/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'obj', name: m[1] });
    } else if ((m = /^class\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'class', name: m[1] });
    } else if ((m = /^(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Z0-9_]{2,})\s*=/.exec(t))) {
      out.push({ ln: i + 1, kind: 'const', name: m[1] });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function javaSymbols(content) {
  const lines = lineNumbersOf(content);
  const classes = [];
  const methods = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const t = lines[i].trim();
    let m;
    if ((m = /^(?:(?:public|private|protected|static|final|abstract)\s+)*(?:class|interface|enum)\s+(\w+)/.exec(t))) {
      classes.push({ ln: i + 1, name: m[1] });
      continue;
    }
    if (/^(?:public|private|protected|static|final|synchronized|abstract|native|default)\b/.test(t) && t.includes('(') && !t.includes('=')) {
      const mm = /([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\([^;]*\)\s*(?:throws [\w., ]+)?\s*\{?\s*$/.exec(t);
      if (mm && !CTRL.has(mm[1])) {
        methods.push({ ln: i + 1, name: mm[1] });
      }
    }
  }
  return { classes, methods };
}

## BAGIAN 4 — Titik Integrasi SimpleCache

1. **Titik masuk audio** — `NativeAudioEngine.java:1031-1042` (exo branch, `eng.play` via GrowingFileDataSource) dan `NativeAudioEngine.java:1062,1064,1066` (mp.setDataSource LSS proxy + prepareAsync). Ganti dengan `CacheDataSource.Factory(SimpleCache, upstream HttpDataSource, FileDataSource)` di `ExoPlaybackEngine` (kini `ProgressiveMediaSource` + custom factory `ExoPlaybackEngine.java:430,432`); MediaPlayer path pensiun atau tetap LSS bila MediaPlayer dipertahankan.
2. **Titik resolve URL** — `NativeAudioEngine.java:749` (`VisionOsResolver.resolve`) + refresh `SongCache.java:849,866`. Ganti dengan `ResolvingDataSource.Factory` (atau `ResolvingMediaSource`) panggil `VisionOsResolver.resolve(videoId)` per `MediaItem`-key videoId; visitorData refresh tetap di dalam resolver.
3. **Titik cache management** — tulis: `SongCache.java:456,463` (fetch + append `.part`); baca: `SongCache.java:633 localBytes`, `656 hasBytes`, `647 chunkEndFor`; hapus: `SongCache.java:721 dropPart`, `729 delete`, `304 enforceLimit`. Ganti tulis/baca/hapus dengan `SimpleCache` API (`commitFile`, `getCachedBytes`, `removeResource`, `CacheEvictor`); record `.song.json` (`SongCache.java:114-116`) KEEP sebagai metadata (atau pindah kolom DB).
4. **Titik monitor progress** — kirim: `NativeAudioEngine.java:1973` timeUpdate + `SongCache.java:559` cacheProgress via `CacheEvents.java:15`; terima JS: `public/app.js:2201-2208` mirror + `4696-4699` have/total. Ganti dengan `player.getBufferedPosition()` + `simpleCache.getCachedBytes(key)`; dl-fill (`public/app.js:3246-3248`) dari cachedBytes/total.
5. **Titik download offline** — `public/app.js:4525 downloadOffline` → `MainActivity.java:1216 cacheSong` → `SongCache.downloadFull SongCache.java:62-78`. Ganti dengan `DownloadManager` + `DownloadService`, key = videoId, meta dari `.song.json`.

## BAGIAN 7 — Risiko, Blocker, dan Pertanyaan

### 7.1 Risiko
1. **Key cache tak stabil** — SimpleCache key default = URL; URL VisionOS expire → cache miss tiap resolve baru. Dampak: cache tak pernah hit, kuota boros. Mitigasi: `CacheKeyFactory` tetap = videoId (+itag), bukan URL.
2. **`.part` lama yatim** — migrasi tinggalkan `.webm.part`/`.webm` tanpa referensi SimpleCache. Dampak: storage ganda. Mitigasi: sekali jalan migrasi atau hapus `.part` + re-download; catat di CHANGELOG.
3. **Hold-to-wake hilang** — growing-hold custom (LSS 90s / Growing 20s) hilang saat pindah CacheDataSource. Dampak: balik stuck baca di luar window. Mitigasi: andalkan `getBufferedPosition` + `ResolvingDataSource` retry; uji lagu >5 mnt.
4. **EOS premature balik** — classifier andalkan consumed/avail custom. Dampak: auto-next salah. Mitigasi: KEEP ExoStateMirror + ExoEosClassifier, peta ke `STATE_ENDED` + buffered-DUR check.
5. **403 identity** — refresh visitorData kini manual per chunk. Dampak: ResolvingDataSource naive perma-403. Mitigasi: resolver wrapper panggil `refreshVisitor` + re-resolve maks 2x (budget kini).
6. **Notif/session ganda** — dua service (1001 legacy vs 1002 media3). Dampak: notif dobel. Mitigasi: gate `useExo()` sudah ada; hapus legacy setelah MediaPlayer pensiun.
7. **Offline beta terpisah** — dua sistem cache (lagu vs beta segments). Dampak: user bingung, kuota ganda 500MB. Mitigasi: satukan DownloadManager, beta flag tetap.

### 7.2 Blocker (HARUS selesai sebelum Fase 1)
1. Tambah `media3-datasource` (CacheDataSource) + putuskan provider DB (`media3-database` vs custom) — grep kini nihil SimpleCache/CacheDataSource/DatabaseProvider.
2. Konfirmasi backend default: `USE_EXOPLAYER=true` (`ExoPlayerFlags.java:17`) — YA default Exo, MediaPlayer legacy. Putuskan: MediaPlayer dipertahankan atau pensiun (tentukan nasib LSS + PlaybackService).
3. Putuskan nasib `.part` lama: migrasi sekali vs hapus + re-download (pengaruhi storage + UX offline).
4. Putuskan key cache: videoId vs URL (wajib sebelum tulis kode cache).

### 7.3 Pertanyaan untuk User
1. Tombol "Download offline" tetap ada (DownloadManager) atau cukup streaming cache?
2. User perlu atur max cache size (kuota MB), atau cukup max_cached_songs kini?
3. `.part`/`.webm` lama dimigrasi atau boleh re-download?
4. MediaPlayer legacy dipertahankan sebagai fallback, atau Exo penuh?
5. Metadata lagu tetap `.song.json` file atau pindah Room/SQLite?

## READY FOR FASE 1?

❌ BELUM. Blocker 1-4 (7.2) belum diputuskan. Setelah user jawab 5 pertanyaan + tambah dependency media3-datasource/database, audit ini cukup sebagai fondasi Fase 1 (SimpleCache migration).
```

```powershell
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$src = Resolve-Path "public\icon-512.png"
$img = [System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($src.Path)
Write-Host "src $($img.Width)x$($img.Height)"
$sizes = @{
  'mipmap-mdpi'=48
  'mipmap-hdpi'=72
  'mipmap-xhdpi'=96
  'mipmap-xxhdpi'=144
  'mipmap-xxxhdpi'=192
}
foreach ($k in $sizes.Keys) {
  $s = $sizes[$k]
  $bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $s,$s
  $g = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp)
  $g.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
  $g.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::Black)
  $g.DrawImage($img,0,0,$s,$s)
  $path = "android\app\src\main\res\$k\ic_launcher.png"
  $bmp.Save((Resolve-Path $path).Path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
  $g.Dispose(); $bmp.Dispose()
  Write-Host "wrote $k $s"
  # also round
  $pathR = "android\app\src\main\res\$k\ic_launcher_round.png"
  $bmp2 = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $s,$s
  $g2 = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp2)
  $g2.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
  $g2.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::Transparent)
  # clip circle
  $gp = New-Object System.Drawing.Drawing2D.GraphicsPath
  $gp.AddEllipse(0,0,$s,$s)
  $g2.SetClip($gp)
  $g2.DrawImage($img,0,0,$s,$s)
  $bmp2.Save((Resolve-Path $pathR).Path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
  $g2.Dispose(); $bmp2.Dispose()
  Write-Host "wrote $k round"
  # foreground (same for adaptive)
  $pathF = "android\app\src\main\res\$k\ic_launcher_foreground.png"
  $bmp3 = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap $s,$s
  $g3 = [System.Drawing.Graphics]::FromImage($bmp3)
  $g3.InterpolationMode = [System.Drawing.Drawing2D.InterpolationMode]::HighQualityBicubic
  $g3.Clear([System.Drawing.Color]::Transparent)
  $g3.DrawImage($img,0,0,$s,$s)
  $bmp3.Save((Resolve-Path $pathF).Path, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png)
  $g3.Dispose(); $bmp3.Dispose()
  Write-Host "wrote $k fg"
}
$img.Dispose()
Write-Host "done"
```
